The contract provided that, rather than paying the songwriter, the candidate was to pay the money to the songwriter's daughter. The contract also prohibited the assignment of any rights or duties arising under the contract without the permission of the other party. She did not secure the permission of the political candidate before making this transfer. The songwriter composed the song, which the candidate used in his campaign, but the candidate did not pay anyone for the song. The charity filed suit against the candidate for breach of contract. Will the charity prevail in its action against the candidate?

The contract was silent regarding delegation, and the orchard, acting in good faith, delegated its duties under the contract to a third party. After asking for, and receiving, assurances from the third party that the peaches would conform to contract specifications, the cannery accepted the delegation. The third party delivered the peaches, which the cannery rejected because the peaches did not conform to the contract specifications. The cannery sued both the orchard and the third party. The orchard moved to dismiss the claims against it.
Should the court dismiss the suit against the orchard?

A tree-cutter who was an expert in removing branches that threaten tall buildings contracted, in a signed writing, to lift and trim branches near a building where a major conference was scheduled to occur. An exculpatory clause in the contract provided that the tree-cutter would not be liable for any physical damage to the building occurring during removal of the branches. There was also a clause providing for per diem damages if the tree-cutter did not complete performance by a specified date and a clause providing that "time is of the essence." Another clause provided that any subsequent agreement for extra work under the contract must be in writing and signed by both parties.
With ample time remaining under the contract for commencement and completion of his performance, the tree-cutter notified the building owner that he was selling his business to a landscaper, who was equally an expert in removing branches that threaten tall buildings, and that the landscaper had agreed to "take over the contract."
If the building owner refuses to accept the landscaper's services, which of the following clauses in the contract will best support the owner's contention that the tree-cutter's duties under the contract were not delegable without the owner's consent?

choices.a: The exculpatory clause.
choices.b: The extra-work clause.
choices.c: The liquidated-damage clause.
choices.d: The "time is of the essence" clause.

一名擅长清除对高楼构成威胁的树枝的修剪工，签订了一份书面合同，为一栋计划举行重要会议的建筑物吊运并修剪附近的树枝。合同中的一项免责条款规定，该修剪工对修剪树枝过程中对建筑物造成的任何物理损坏概不负责。合同中还有一项条款，规定如果修剪工未在指定日期前完成履约，将按日计算违约金，以及一项规定“时间至关重要”的条款。另一项条款规定，任何后续关于合同项下额外工作的协议都必须以书面形式订立，并由双方签字。

在合同规定的履约开始和完成时间尚且充裕的情况下，该修剪工通知业主，他正将自己的业务出售给一名园艺师，该园艺师同样是清除威胁高楼的树枝方面的专家，并且该园艺师已同意“接管此合同”。

如果业主拒绝接受该园艺师的服务，合同中的下列哪一条款最能支持业主的以下主张：未经其同意，修剪工的合同义务不可委托？
options:
A. The exculpatory clause.
免责条款。

B. The extra-work clause.
额外工作条款。

C. The liquidated-damage clause.
约定违约金条款。

D. The "time is of the essence" clause.
“时间至关重要”条款。
data.explanation:
Assignment v. Delegation


AssignmentTransfer of contractual rights to another (ie, assignee)
DelegationTransfer of contractual duties to another (ie, delegatee)
An exculpatory clause releases a party (eg, the tree-cutter) from liability for damages caused during the execution of the contract. Such a clause would effectively release that party from liability for damages caused by a delegatee (eg, the landscaper) as well.

This goes against the controlling principle that a delegating party is not released from liability for damages caused by a delegatee unless the other party to the contract (eg, the building owner) expressly agrees to a release. As a result, the exculpatory clause best supports the building owner's contention that the tree-cutter's duties were not delegable without the owner's consent.

(Choice B) The extra-work clause limits the scope of work to be done, but it says nothing about who is permitted to perform that work.

(Choice C) The liquidated-damage clause sets forth a fixed measure of damages for breach; it has no bearing on whether the tree-cutter can delegate his duties without the building owner's consent.

(Choice D) The "time is of the essence" clause indicates that performance by the time specified in the contract is crucial for the building owner to receive the benefit of the bargain. But this clause does not determine whether the tree-cutter can delegate his duties without the building owner's consent.

Educational objective: An exculpatory clause releases a party from liability for damages caused during the execution of the contract. This would include damages caused by a delegatee, so the party to be released cannot delegate his/her duties without the other party's consent.

权利转让与义务委托


Assignment (权利转让)将合同权利转让给另一方（即受让人）
Delegation (义务委托)将合同义务委托给另一方（即受托人）
免责条款是指免除一方（例如，修剪工）在合同履行期间所造成损害的责任。此类条款同样可以有效地免除该方因受托人（例如，园艺师）造成的损害而应承担的责任。

这与一项管控原则相悖，即委托方并不会因受托人造成的损害而被免除责任，除非合同另一方（例如，业主）明确同意免责。因此，免责条款最能支持业主的以下主张：未经其同意，修剪工的合同义务不可委托。

（选项B）额外工作条款限制了待完成工作的范围，但并未说明允许由谁来履行该工作。

（选项C）约定违约金条款规定了固定的违约赔偿标准；但这与修剪工是否可以在未经业主同意的情况下委托其义务无关。

（选项D）“时间至关重要”条款表明，在合同规定时间内履约对于业主获得交易利益至关重要。但该条款并未决定修剪工是否可以在未经业主同意的情况下委托其义务。

教学目标：免责条款免除一方在合同履行期间所造成损害的责任。这也包括由受托人造成的损害，因此，被免责方未经另一方同意，不得委托其义务。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 318 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (delegation of duties).

MBE 考点解析

合同法：义务的委托 (Delegation of Duties)
核心原则：委托后的责任归属

在合同法中，当一方（Delegator）将义务委托给第三方（Delegatee）时，原合同方并不会因此免除责任。如果第三方搞砸了，原合同方仍需负责。

除非：债权人（Obligee）明确同意免除原合同方的责任（这称为 Novation，债务更替）。

为什么选 A (免责条款)？

本题的关键在于风险分配的变化。

1. 常规情况：
通常，如果修剪工（Tree-cutter）委托工作给园艺师，而园艺师损坏了房子，业主可以起诉修剪工。因为委托不免责。

2. 本题的特殊情况：
合同中有一个免责条款 (Exculpatory Clause)，规定修剪工对物理损坏概不负责。

3. 逻辑推演：
如果允许委托，且修剪工依据条款免责，那么当受托人（园艺师）造成损害时，业主将陷入极其被动的局面：

  • 修剪工会说：“看合同，我有免责条款，我不赔。”
  • 业主可能无法依据原合同起诉园艺师（缺乏直接合同关系，Privity of Contract）。

结论：
免责条款的存在意味着业主是基于对特定修剪工的信任才放弃了索赔权。如果换人履行，业主的风险将显著增加（Substantial change in risk）。因此，该条款最能证明此合同义务具有人身专属性，未经同意不可委托。

其他选项为何不支持？
选项 B (额外工作条款) 错误：
该条款仅规定了修改合同范围（Modification）的形式要求，与谁来履行工作无关。
选项 C (约定违约金条款) 错误：
Liquidated Damages Clause 仅预设了违约时的赔偿金额。无论是由修剪工还是园艺师违约，赔偿计算方式都不受影响，因此不影响委托权。
选项 D (时间至关重要条款) 错误：
"Time is of the essence" 强调的是履行的时间而非履行的主体。只要园艺师能在规定时间内完成，该条款并未被违反。
💡 MBE 解题技巧：
在判断“义务是否可委托”时，不要只看工作是否需要特殊技能。要寻找是否存在“实质性改变债权人期待或风险”的因素。本题中，免责条款就是那个改变风险分配的关键变量。

A famous chef entered into a written agreement with a well-known interior decorator, who was respected for his unique designs, to design the interior of the chef's new restaurant and, upon the chef's approval of the design plan, to decorate and furnish the restaurant accordingly. The agreement was silent as to assignment or delegation by either party.
Before beginning the work, the interior decorator sold his decorating business to a new decorator under an agreement in which the interior decorator assigned to the new decorator, and the new decorator agreed to complete, the chef's contract. The new decorator, also an experienced decorator of excellent repute, advised the chef of the assignment, and supplied him with information confirming both the new decorator's financial responsibility and past commercial success.
Is the chef obligated to permit the new decorator to perform the agreement?

choices.a: No, because the interior decorator's duties were of a personal nature, involving his reputation, taste, and skill.
choices.b: No, because the interior decorator's purported delegation to the new decorator of the interior decorator's obligations to the chef effected a novation.
choices.c: Yes, because the agreement contained no prohibition against assignment or delegation.
choices.d: Yes, because the chef received adequate assurances of the new decorator's ability to complete the job.

一位著名厨师与一位因其独特设计而备受推崇的知名室内设计师签订了一份书面协议，协议约定由设计师为其新餐厅进行室内设计，并在厨师批准设计方案后，相应地对餐厅进行装修和布置。该协议对任何一方的权利转让或义务委托事宜未作规定。

在开始工作前，该室内设计师根据一份协议将其装修业务出售给了一位新设计师，协议中，原室内设计师将与厨师的合同转让给了新设计师，而新设计师也同意完成该合同。这位新设计师也是一位经验丰富、声誉卓著的设计师，他将转让事宜通知了厨师，并向厨师提供了信息，以证实其财务责任能力和过往的商业成功。

该厨师是否有义务允许新设计师履行该协议？
options:
A. No, because the interior decorator's duties were of a personal nature, involving his reputation, taste, and skill.
否，因为室内设计师的义务具有人身性质，涉及其声誉、品味和技能。

B. No, because the interior decorator's purported delegation to the new decorator of the interior decorator's obligations to the chef effected a novation.
否，因为原室内设计师声称将其对厨师的义务委托给新设计师的行为，构成了一项合同更新 (novation)。

C. Yes, because the agreement contained no prohibition against assignment or delegation.
是，因为该协议未包含禁止权利转让或义务委托的条款。

D. Yes, because the chef received adequate assurances of the new decorator's ability to complete the job.
是，因为厨师收到了关于新设计师有能力完成工作的充分保证。
data.explanation:
Nondelegable contractual duties

Delegation not permitted when:

  • other contracting party has substantial interest in having delegating party perform (eg, in personal-services contract involving taste or special skill) or
  • delegation is prohibited by contract

Although public policy favors free assignment of contractual rights and free delegation of contractual duties, delegation is not permitted when:

  • the other party to the contract has a substantial interest in having the delegating party perform (eg, in a personal-services contract involving taste or a special skill) or
  • the delegation is prohibited by the contract (eg, the contract says "this contract may not be assigned").

Here, the well-known interior decorator, who was respected for his unique designs, agreed in writing to design the chef's new restaurant. Although the agreement was silent as to assignment or delegation, the chef had a substantial interest in having the interior decorator perform. That is because the interior decorator's duties were of a personal nature, involving his reputation, taste, and skill. Therefore, the interior decorator could not delegate his duties, and the chef is not required to permit the new decorator to perform the agreement (Choice C).

(Choice B) A novation is a substituted contract in which the parties agree to replace an original contracting party with a new party. Here, the interior decorator's purported delegation to the new decorator was not a novation since the chef never agreed to replace the interior decorator with the new decorator.

(Choice D) The fact that the chef received adequate assurances of the new decorator's ability to complete the job (eg, information regarding the new decorator's past commercial success) is irrelevant.

Educational objective: Delegation of contractual duties is not permitted when (1) the other party to the contract has a substantial interest in having the delegating party perform or (2) the contract prohibits delegation.

不可委托的合同义务

在下列情况下，义务委托是不被允许的：

  • 合同另一方在由委托方履行合同方面有重大利益（例如，在涉及品味或特殊技能的个人服务合同中）或
  • 合同禁止委托

尽管公共政策倾向于支持合同权利的自由转让和合同义务的自由委托，但在下列情况下，义务委托是不被允许的：

  • 合同的另一方在由委托方履行合同方面有重大利益（例如，在涉及品味或特殊技能的个人服务合同中）或
  • 委托被合同所禁止（例如，合同规定“本合同不得转让”）。

在本案中，这位因其独特设计而备受推崇的知名室内设计师，书面同意为厨师的新餐厅进行设计。尽管协议对权利转让或义务委托未作规定，但厨师在由该室内设计师本人履行合同方面有重大利益。这是因为室内设计师的义务具有人身性质，涉及其声誉、品味和技能。因此，该室内设计师不能委托其义务，厨师也无需允许新设计师履行该协议 (选项 C)。

(选项 B) 合同更新 (novation) 是一种替代合同，指各方当事人同意用一个新当事人替换原合同当事人。在本案中，原室内设计师声称将义务委托给新设计师的行为不是一次合同更新，因为厨师从未同意用新设计师替换原室内设计师。

(选项 D) 厨师收到了关于新设计师有能力完成工作的充分保证（例如，关于新设计师过往商业成功的信息）这一事实，与本案无关。

教学目标：合同义务的委托在以下情况下不被允许：(1) 合同另一方在由委托方履行合同方面有重大利益，或 (2) 合同禁止委托。

"

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 318 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (delegation of performance of duty).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Third-Party Rights
核心考点：合同义务的委托

一般规则： 合同义务通常是可以委托给第三方履行的 (Delegable)，除非合同明确禁止。

例外情况 (本题关键)： 如果义务涉及独特的个人技能、品味或判断 (Personal judgment, skill, or taste)，则未经债权人同意，该义务不可委托。

👨‍🍳 名厨 (Chef)
(依赖设计师的独特品味)
⬇️ 🚫 委托被阻断
🎨 知名设计师 (Decorator)
(Unique Designs & Reputation)
为什么选 A？

本题考察的是 Delegation of Duties（义务委托）的限制。

🎯
人身性质的服务 (Personal Services)：
题目特别强调了设计师是“因其独特设计而备受推崇” (respected for his unique designs)。室内设计不仅仅是体力劳动，它高度依赖个人的艺术审美和声誉。
⚖️
法律后果：
当合同履行涉及特定的个人才华时，债权人（厨师）有权要求特定的债务人（原设计师）履行。这种情况下，义务是不可委托的 (Non-delegable)。
✅ 选项 A 正确：
因为它准确指出了拒绝委托的法律依据——设计师的义务具有人身性质 (Personal nature)，涉及声誉、品味和技能。
为什么其他选项错误？
❌
选项 B (Novation)：
合同更新 (Novation) 需要所有三方（包括厨师）的一致同意，用新合同取代旧合同。本案中厨师并未同意，因此不构成 Novation。
❌
选项 C (Silence in Contract)：
虽然合同未禁止委托，但普通法 (Common Law) 默认规则中包含了“个人技能服务不可委托”的例外。沉默不代表允许转让具有人身性质的义务。
❌
选项 D (Adequate Assurances)：
如果义务本身是不可委托的（如本案），新设计师的能力再强、保证再充分也无关紧要。厨师买的是原设计师的“独特设计”，而不是任何合格设计师的服务。
🎓 MBE 答题技巧

在合同法题目中，如果看到服务提供者被描述为"Famous" (著名的)、"Unique" (独特的) 或涉及"Artistic taste" (艺术品味)，这通常是提示你该合同属于个人服务合同 (Personal Services Contract)，其义务通常不可委托。

Reference: Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 318

An accountant and a bookkeeper, as part of a contract dissolving their accounting business, agreed that each would contribute $100,000 to fund an annuity for a clerk who was a longtime employee of the business. The clerk's position would be terminated at the dissolution, and he did not have a retirement plan. The accountant and the bookkeeper informed the clerk of their plan to fund an annuity for him. The clerk, confident about his financial future because of the promised annuity, purchased a retirement home. The accountant later contributed his $100,000 to fund the annuity, but the bookkeeper stated that he could afford to contribute only $50,000. The accountant agreed in writing that the bookkeeper should contribute only $50,000.
Does the clerk have a valid basis for an action against the bookkeeper for the unpaid $50,000?

choices.a: No, because the clerk was bound by the modification of the contract made by the accountant and the bookkeeper.
choices.b: No, because the clerk was only a donee beneficiary of the contract between the accountant and the bookkeeper and had no vested rights.
choices.c: Yes, because the clerk's reliance on the promised annuity prevented the parties from changing the terms of the contract.
choices.d: Yes, because the promise to establish the annuity was made binding by consideration from the clerk's many years of employment.

options:
A. No, because the clerk was bound by the modification of the contract made by the accountant and the bookkeeper.
没有，因为办事员受到会计师和簿记员对合同所做修改的约束。

有，因为办事员对所承诺年金的信赖，导致合同双方当事人不能再变更合同条款。

D. Yes, because the promise to establish the annuity was made binding by consideration from the clerk's many years of employment.

Third-party beneficiaries


(ie, nonparties who benefit from contract)
TypeDefinitionRight to enforce
IntendedReceive direct benefit from contract because contracting parties intended to benefit them Eg, A promises to paint B's house if B promises to pay $500 to CYes
IncidentalReceive indirect benefit from contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them Eg, A promises to buy B a car manufactured by CNo
A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. If the contracting parties intended for the contract to benefit the third party, the third party is an intended beneficiary. Only intended (not incidental) beneficiaries have enforceable rights under the contract. Those rights vest when the beneficiary:

  • detrimentally relies on the rights created
  • manifests assent to the contract at one party's request or
  • files a lawsuit to enforce the contract.


Once this occurs, the original contracting parties are bound to perform the contract. Any efforts to rescind or modify the contract after vesting are void unless the beneficiary agrees to the rescission or modification.

Here, the clerk was an intended beneficiary of the accountant-bookkeeper contract because the parties' promise to fund an annuity for the clerk was clearly intended to benefit him. The clerk detrimentally relied on the promised annuity by purchasing a retirement home (vesting). And since he did so before the accountant and the bookkeeper agreed that the bookkeeper would contribute $50,000 less, their attempt to modify the contract was void. As a result, the clerk has a valid basis for an action against the bookkeeper for the unpaid $50,000 (Choice A).

(Choice B) A donee beneficiary is an intended beneficiary of a gift promise, while a creditor beneficiary is an intended beneficiary to whom the promisee owed money. The rule for vesting is the same for both.

(Choice D) Under the bargained-for exchange test for consideration, past performance (eg, the clerk's many years of employment) does not constitute the consideration required to enforce a contract. Instead, the clerk can enforce the accountant-bookkeeper contract because of his third-party beneficiary status.

Educational objective: An intended beneficiary's contractual rights vest when the beneficiary
  • detrimentally relies on the rights created,
  • manifests assent to the contract, or
  • files a lawsuit to enforce it.
Any efforts to rescind or modify the contract after vesting are void unless the beneficiary agrees to the rescission or modification.

（即从合同中受益的非合同方）
类型定义执行权

第三方受益人是指从合同中获得某种利益或好处的非合同方。如果合同方意图让合同惠及第三方，则该第三方是意图受益人。只有意图受益人（而非附带受益人）才拥有合同项下的可执行权利。当受益人出现以下情况时，这些权利即既定：

  • 对所创设的权利产生了不利信赖
  • 应一方当事人的要求表示同意该合同或
  • 提起诉讼以执行合同。


一旦发生上述情况，原合同方即有义务履行合同。在权利既定后，任何撤销或修改合同的尝试均属无效，除非受益人同意该撤销或修改。

在本案中，办事员是会计师与簿记员合同的意图受益人，因为双方当事人为其提供年金的承诺显然是为了使其受益。办事员因购买养老用的房屋而对承诺的年金产生了不利信赖（权利既定）。并且，由于他这么做的时间早于会计师和簿记员同意簿记员少出资50,000美元，他们修改合同的尝试是无效的。因此，办事员有有效依据就未支付的50,000美元对簿记员提起诉讼（选项A）。

（选项B）受赠受益人是赠与承诺的意图受益人，而债权人受益人是受诺人（promisee）对其负有债务的意图受益人。两者权利既定的规则是相同的。

（选项D）根据对价的“协议交换”检验标准，过去的履行（例如，办事员多年的雇佣服务）不构成强制执行合同所需的对价。相反，办事员可以凭借其第三方受益人的身份来执行会计师与簿记员之间的合同。

教学目标：意图受益人的合同权利在受益人出现以下情况时既定：
  • 对所创设的权利产生了不利信赖，
  • 表示同意该合同，或
  • 提起诉讼以执行合同。
在权利既定后，任何撤销或修改合同的尝试均属无效，除非受益人同意该撤销或修改。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 311 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (variation of a duty to a beneficiary).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Third-Party Rights

📚 核心考点：受益人权利的既定 (Vesting)

在合同法中，原合同双方（Promisor & Promisee）原则上可以随时修改或撤销合同。但是，一旦意图受益人 (Intended Beneficiary) 的权利既定 (Vest)，原合同双方就失去了未经受益人同意而修改合同的权利。

权利既定的三个触发条件：

  1. 受益人对合同表示同意 (Manifests assent)；
  2. 受益人提起诉讼 (Brings suit) 执行合同；
  3. 受益人在信赖 (Reliance) 合同的基础上实质性地改变了自己的立场（即不利信赖）。
⚖️ 案情逻辑分析

本题考察的是上述第三个条件：信赖 (Reliance)。

1. 识别角色：

  • 合同方：会计师 (Accountant) 和 簿记员 (Bookkeeper)。
  • 第三方：办事员 (Clerk)。他是“意图受益人”，因为合同明确规定要给他年金。

2. 关键时间线：

  • 合同达成，承诺给 Clerk 年金。
  • Clerk 被告知此计划。
  • 关键点：Clerk 基于对年金的信赖，购买了退休房屋 (Detrimental Reliance)。此时，权利既定 (Rights Vested)。
  • 之后，Bookkeeper 试图修改合同减少出资，Accountant 同意。

3. 结论：

由于 Clerk 的权利在修改之前已经既定，Accountant 和 Bookkeeper 随后的修改对 Clerk 无效。Clerk 有权要求执行原合同条款。

✅ 正确答案 C 准确描述了这一法律原则。

🚫 陷阱排除
选项 A 错误 (修改有效论) 如果 Clerk 没有购买房屋（没有信赖行为），也没有起诉或表示同意，那么合同双方确实可以修改合同。但本题中权利已既定，修改无效。
选项 B 错误 (受赠受益人无权论) Clerk 确实是受赠受益人 (Donee Beneficiary)（因为年金是礼物，而非偿还债务）。但现代法律（Restatement 2nd）规定，受赠受益人的权利一旦既定，同样受法律保护，不可随意撤销。
选项 D 错误 (过去的对价) 这是一个常见的干扰项。Clerk 多年的工作是过去的履行 (Past Performance)，在合同法中通常不构成新承诺的有效对价 (Consideration)。Clerk 胜诉的基础是其第三方受益人身份 + 信赖，而不是因为他提供了对价。
💡 MBE 提分技巧：
看到“两人签合同惠及第三人”的题目，立即检查第三人是否知道并采取了行动（信赖、起诉、同意）。
  • 如果已行动 -> 权利锁定，原合同方不能改。
  • 如果未行动 -> 权利未锁定，原合同方可以改。

The owner of a fleet of taxis contracted with a dealer in petroleum products for the purchase and sale of the fleet owner's total requirements of gasoline and oil for one year. As part of that agreement, the petroleum dealer also agreed with the fleet owner that for one year the petroleum dealer would place all his advertising with the fleet owner's wife, who owned her own small advertising agency. When the wife was informed of the contract, she declined to accept an advertising account from another company because she could not handle both accounts during the same year. The fleet owner performed his contract with the petroleum dealer for six months, and during that time the petroleum dealer placed his advertising with the wife. At the end of the six months, the fleet owner and the wife were divorced, and the fleet owner then told the petroleum dealer that he had no further obligation to place his advertising with the fleet owner's now ex-wife. The petroleum dealer thereupon notified the ex-wife that he would no longer place his advertising with her.
In an action by the wife against the petroleum dealer for breach of contract, will the wife likely succeed?

choices.a: No, because absent a provision in the contract to the contrary, the promisor and promisee of a third-party beneficiary contract retain by law the right to modify or terminate the contract.
choices.b: No, because the agency relationship, if any, between the fleet owner and the wife terminated upon their divorce.
choices.c: Yes, because the fleet owner acted in bad faith in releasing the petroleum dealer from his duty with respect to the fleet owner's wife.
choices.d: Yes, because the petroleum dealer and the fleet owner could not, without the wife's consent, modify their contract so as to discharge the petroleum dealer's duties to the wife.

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Third-Party Rights
核心概念：权利既定 (Vesting)

本题考察的是第三方受益人（Third-Party Beneficiary）的权利何时“既定”（Vest），以及权利既定后对原合同双方修改合同能力的限制。

1. 法律规则 (The Rule)

根据《合同法重述（第二版）》§ 311，一旦意定受益人（Intended Beneficiary）的权利既定 (Vested)，原合同双方（Promisor 和 Promisee）就不能在未经受益人同意的情况下修改或解除合同。

权利既定的三个触发条件：

  • 受益人应一方请求，对合同表示同意 (Manifests assent)；
  • 受益人提起诉讼 (Brings suit) 以执行合同；
  • 受益人在知晓合同后，基于对合同的信赖发生了实质性的地位改变 (Materially changes position in justifiable reliance)。
2. 案情应用 (Application)

在本案中，妻子是意定受益人（合同明确规定广告业务给她）。关键事实如下：

  • 妻子得知了合同内容。
  • 基于该合同，她拒绝了另一家公司的业务（因为无法同时处理）。

这一行为构成了信赖损害 (Detrimental Reliance)。因此，妻子的权利在那个时刻已经既定 (Vested)。

3. 结论与正确选项 (D)

一旦权利既定，车队所有人（Fleet Owner）和石油经销商（Dealer）就失去了单方面修改合同以取消给妻子广告业务的权力。

因此，选项 D 正确：未经妻子同意，他们不能修改合同以解除对妻子的义务。

4. 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A： 错误。虽然原则上合同双方可以修改合同，但这一权利在第三方受益人权利既定后即终止。A 选项忽略了“既定”这一关键例外。

选项 B： 错误。本题是合同法下的第三方受益人问题，而非代理法（Agency）问题。妻子并非作为丈夫的代理人，而是作为合同的受益人。

选项 C： 错误。虽然“恶意”（Bad Faith）通常对被告不利，但本题的法律依据并非基于诚信原则，而是基于既定权利（Vested Rights）的不可撤销性。即使丈夫是出于“善意”修改合同，只要妻子的权利已既定且未同意修改，修改依然无效。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在遇到第三方受益人题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 识别身份：第三方是意定受益人（Intended）还是附带受益人（Incidental）？（本题中明确指定受益，为意定）。
  2. 检查既定 (Vesting)：受益人是否已经知道合同并采取了行动（如依赖、起诉或同意）？
  3. 判断后果：如果已既定，原合同双方不得随意修改；如果未既定，原合同双方可以修改。

A seller contracted to manufacture 1,000 toasters for a buyer for a specified price. The contract contained a provision that clearly stated: "This contract may not be assigned, and any violation of this prohibition voids the contract." After the contract was signed, the seller informed the buyer that the toasters would be manufactured by a competitor of the seller. Citing the nonassignment provision, the buyer claimed that it was no longer bound by the contract. Toasters manufactured by the competitor were of equal quality to toasters manufactured by the seller.
Is the buyer bound by the contract?

choices.a: No, because the seller assigned a right despite the contractual prohibition.
choices.b: No, because "this contract may not be assigned" means that duties may not be delegated, and the seller delegated a duty.
choices.c: Yes, because even though the seller breached the contract, there are no damages since the competitor's toasters are of equal quality to the seller's toasters.

The contract contained a provision that clearly stated: "This contract may not be assigned, and any violation of this prohibition voids the contract." A. No, because the seller assigned a right despite the contractual prohibition.
否，因为卖方在合同禁止的情况下转让了一项权利。

B. No, because "this contract may not be assigned" means that duties may not be delegated, and the seller delegated a duty.
否，因为“本合同不得转让”意味着义务不得委托，而卖方委托了一项义务。

C. Yes, because even though the seller breached the contract, there are no damages since the competitor's toasters are of equal quality to the seller's toasters.
是，因为即使卖方违反了合同，但由于竞争对手的烤面包机与卖方的质量相同，因此没有造成损害。

D. Yes, because the nonassignment provision is not enforceable since public policy favors free assignment and delegation.

Contract provisions prohibiting assignments/delegations


Type of provisionExplicit prohibitionsAssignment of rightsDelegation of duties
NoneN/AAllowedAllowed
SpecificAssignment of rights & delegation of dutiesBarredBarred
Assignment of rights onlyBarredAllowed
Delegation of duties onlyAllowedBarred
GeneralAssignment of "the contract"AllowedBarred
Public policy favors the free assignment of contractual rights and the free delegation of contractual duties. Despite this public policy, contract provisions that prohibit assignment and/or delegation (ie, nonassignment provisions) are enforceable (Choice D). However, a general provision that prohibits assignment of "the contract"—without specifying whether it applies to rights or duties—will be construed to (1) allow the assignment of rights and (2) bar the delegation of duties.

Here, the seller had a contractual duty to manufacture 1,000 toasters and sell them to the buyer. Since the nonassignment provision ("[t]his contract may not be assigned") did not specify whether it applied to rights or duties, it will be construed to mean that duties may not be delegated. But the seller informed the buyer that the seller had delegated its duty to the competitor. And since the contract stated that this violation of the nonassignment provision voided the contract, the buyer is no longer bound.

(Choice A) The seller delegated its duty to manufacture the toasters but did not assign its right to receive payment from the buyer. And since the contract provision did not specify whether it applied to rights or duties, it would have allowed the seller to assign its right (had the seller done so), and the buyer would still have been bound.

(Choice C) The buyer is no longer bound because the seller's violation of the nonassignment provision voided the contract. This is true regardless of whether the buyer suffered any damages.

Educational objective: Nonassignment provisions are enforceable. But a general provision that prohibits assignment of "the contract" without specifying rights or duties will be construed to (1) allow the assignment of rights and (2) bar the delegation of duties.

禁止转让/委托的合同条款


条款类型明确禁令权利转让义务委托
无不适用允许允许
具体规定权利转让与义务委托禁止禁止
仅权利转让禁止允许
仅义务委托允许禁止
一般规定“合同”的转让允许禁止
公共政策倾向于支持合同权利的自由转让和合同义务的自由委托。尽管有此公共政策，禁止转让和/或委托的合同条款（即禁止转让条款）是可执行的（选项D）。然而，一项禁止“合同”转让的一般性条款——在未指明其适用于权利还是义务的情况下——将被解释为 (1) 允许权利的转让，以及 (2) 禁止义务的委托。

在本案中，卖方有合同义务为买方制造1000台烤面包机并出售给买方。由于禁止转让条款（“本合同不得转让”）未指明其适用于权利还是义务，因此该条款将被解释为义务不得委托。但卖方通知买方，其已将义务委托给竞争对手。并且，由于合同规定违反此禁止转让条款将导致合同无效，因此买方不再受合同约束。

(选项 A) 卖方委托了其制造烤面包机的义务，但未转让其从买方处收取款项的权利。并且，由于合同条款未指明其适用于权利还是义务，该条款本应允许卖方转让其权利（如果卖方这样做的话），而买方仍将受合同约束。

(选项 C) 买方不再受合同约束，因为卖方违反禁止转让条款的行为导致了合同无效。无论买方是否遭受任何损害，这一点都成立。

教学目的： 禁止转让条款是可执行的。但一项禁止“合同”转让而未指明是权利还是义务的一般性条款，将被解释为 (1) 允许权利的转让，以及 (2) 禁止义务的委托。

References
•
Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 322 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that a contract term prohibiting assignment of "the contract" bars only the delegation of a duty).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Assignment & Delegation
核心考点：合同转让条款的解释

本题考察的是当合同中出现一般性的“禁止转让”条款（General Nonassignment Clause）时，法律如何解释其含义。

关键在于区分两个概念：

  • Assignment of Rights (权利转让)：将接受履行的权利（如收款）转给第三方。
  • Delegation of Duties (义务委托)：将履行合同的义务（如制造产品）交给第三方。
UCC § 2-210 & Restatement § 322

根据《统一商法典》(UCC) 和《合同法重述》，如果合同条款仅笼统地规定"The contract may not be assigned" (本合同不得转让)，而未具体区分权利或义务，法律的默认解释规则是：

  1. 禁止义务的委托 (Bars Delegation of Duties)：卖方不得让其他人来履行义务。
  2. 允许权利的转让 (Allows Assignment of Rights)：通常仍然允许转让收款权等权利（除非转让会实质性增加对方的风险或负担）。

本案分析

1. 事实认定：
卖方找了竞争对手来制造烤面包机。这属于Delegation of Duties (义务委托)，而非权利转让。

2. 条款解释：
合同规定 "This contract may not be assigned"。根据上述规则，这句话被解释为禁止义务委托。

3. 结论：
卖方委托竞争对手制造，违反了禁止委托的解释。且合同明确规定违反此条款导致合同无效 (voids the contract)。因此，买方不再受合同约束。

正确答案 B 解析：
这是对法律规则的直接应用。笼统的禁止转让条款被解释为禁止义务委托。卖方委托了制造义务，构成了违约。

选项 A 错误
卖方并没有转让“权利”（如收款权），而是委托了“义务”（制造）。此外，即使卖方转让了权利，根据解释规则，笼统条款通常并不禁止权利转让。

选项 C 错误
虽然产品质量相同（无实际损害），但卖方违反了明确的合同禁令（禁止委托）。合同明确规定违反该条款会导致合同无效 (Void)，因此买方有权拒绝履行，无需证明损害。

选项 D 错误
虽然公共政策支持自由转让，但禁止转让/委托的条款在法律上是可执行的。当事人有权通过合同限制委托。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)：
在 MBE 中看到 "Assignment of the Contract"（合同转让）这个短语时，要立即反应出它的双重含义：
1. 它是Delegation（委托）的禁令；
2. 它通常不是 Assignment（权利转让）的禁令。
除非题目明确说 "Rights under this contract may not be assigned"。

questions.question:
Collection of a debtor's $2,000 debt to a creditor was barred by the applicable statute of limitations. The debtor sold and delivered his car to a buyer under a written agreement, signed by the buyer, in which the buyer promised to pay the $2,000 purchase price to the creditor "in satisfaction of [the debtor's] debt to [the creditor]."
Can the creditor recover the $2,000 from the buyer?

choices.a: No, because payment of the $2,000 to the creditor would undermine the statutory public policy against enforcement of stale claims.
choices.b: No, because the creditor's rights as an intended beneficiary are subject to any defenses available to the contracting parties between themselves.
choices.c: Yes, because the buyer's promise to pay $2,000 to the creditor is enforceable by the creditor regardless of whether the debtor was legally obligated to pay the creditor anything.
choices.d: Yes, because the buyer's promise to pay $2,000 to the creditor revived the uncollectible debt.

data.questionStem:
Q81812 Collection of a debtor's $2,000 debt to a creditor was barred by the applicable statute of limitations. The debtor sold and delivered his car to a buyer under a written agreement, signed by the buyer, in which the buyer promised to pay the $2,000 purchase price to the creditor "in satisfaction of [the debtor's] debt to [the creditor]."

Can the creditor recover the $2,000 from the buyer? 债权人向债务人追讨2000美元债务的权利已因适用的诉讼时效届满而被禁止。债务人根据一份由买方签署的书面协议，将其汽车出售并交付给买方。在该协议中，买方承诺将2000美元的购买价款支付给债权人，以“清偿[债务人]对[债权人]的债务”。 债权人能否向买方追讨这2000美元？
options:
A. No, because payment of the $2,000 to the creditor would undermine the statutory public policy against enforcement of stale claims.
不能，因为向债权人支付2000美元会损害禁止强制执行过期债权的法定公共政策。

B. No, because the creditor's rights as an intended beneficiary are subject to any defenses available to the contracting parties between themselves.
不能，因为债权人作为意定受益人的权利，受制于合同当事人之间可以主张的任何抗辩。

C. Yes, because the buyer's promise to pay $2,000 to the creditor is enforceable by the creditor regardless of whether the debtor was legally obligated to pay the creditor anything.
能，因为无论债务人是否在法律上有义务向债权人支付任何款项，买方向债权人支付2000美元的承诺对债权人而言都是可强制执行的。

D. Yes, because the buyer's promise to pay $2,000 to the creditor revived the uncollectible debt.
能，因为买方向债权人支付2000美元的承诺使不可追讨的债务得以恢复。
data.explanation:
Third-party beneficiaries

(ie, nonparties who benefit from contract)
TypeDefinitionRight to enforce
Intended
  • Receive direct benefit from contract because contracting parties intended to benefit them
  • Eg, A promises to paint B's house if B promises to pay $500 to C
Yes
Incidental
  • Receive indirect benefit from contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them
  • Eg, A promises to buy B a car manufactured by C
No
A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. There are two types of third-party beneficiaries:
  • Intended - who receive a direct benefit from the contract because the contracting parties so intended (eg, the contract provides that payment will go directly to a third party)
  • Incidental - who receive some indirect benefit from the contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them (ie, all third-party beneficiaries who are not intended beneficiaries)
Only intended beneficiaries—not incidental beneficiaries—have contractual rights and may sue to enforce them.

Here, the debtor and the buyer agreed that the buyer would pay the $2,000 purchase price directly to the creditor in satisfaction of the debtor's debt to the creditor. This made the creditor an intended third-party beneficiary of the debtor-buyer agreement. Therefore, the creditor can enforce the buyer's promise to pay the $2,000. This is true regardless of whether the debtor was legally obligated to pay the creditor anything (given that the applicable statute of limitations had run) (Choice D).

(Choice A) There is no statutory public policy against enforcement of stale claims. And here, the buyer's promise to pay the creditor the $2,000 is enforceable even if the creditor was time-barred from collecting the debt from the debtor.

(Choice B) The promisor (eg, the buyer) can raise any defense against the third-party beneficiary (eg, the creditor) that the promisor had against the original promisee (eg, the debtor). But there is no indication that the buyer has a defense against the debtor that could be raised against the creditor in this case.

(Choice D) The buyer's promise to pay $2,000 to the creditor did not revive the uncollectible debt—ie, a suit by the creditor to collect the $2,000 from the debtor would still be barred by the applicable statute of limitations.

Educational objective: Third-party beneficiaries are nonparties who receive some advantage or benefit from a contract. But only intended beneficiaries have contractual rights and may sue to enforce them.

第三方受益人

(即从合同中受益的非合同方)
类型定义强制执行权
意定受益人
  • 因合同方意图使其受益而从合同中获得直接利益
  • 例如，A承诺为B的房子刷漆，前提是B承诺向C支付500美元
是
附带受益人
  • 尽管没有使其受益的合同意图，但仍从合同中获得间接利益
  • 例如，A承诺为B购买一辆由C制造的汽车
否
第三方受益人是指从合同中获得某种好处或利益的非合同方。第三方受益人有两种类型：
  • 意定受益人 - 因合同方有意如此而从合同中获得直接利益的人（例如，合同规定直接向第三方付款）
  • 附带受益人 - 尽管没有合同意图使其受益，但仍从合同中获得某些间接利益的人（即所有非意定受益人的第三方受益人）
只有意定受益人——而非附带受益人——才拥有合同权利，并可以提起诉讼以强制执行这些权利。

在本案中，债务人和买方约定，买方将2000美元的购买价款直接支付给债权人，以清偿债务人对债权人的债务。这使得债权人成为债务人与买方之间协议的意定第三方受益人。因此，债权人可以强制执行买方支付2000美元的承诺。无论债务人在法律上是否有义务向债权人支付任何款项（鉴于适用的诉讼时效已过），这一点都成立（选项 D）。

(选项A) 不存在禁止强制执行过期债权的法定公共政策。而且在本案中，即使债权人因时效已过而无法向债务人追讨债务，买方向债权人支付2000美元的承诺仍然是可强制执行的。

(选项B) 承诺人（例如，买方）可以向第三方受益人（例如，债权人）主张其对原受诺人（例如，债务人）所拥有的任何抗辩。但没有迹象表明，在本案中买方对债务人有任何可以向债权人主张的抗辩。

(选项D) 买方向债权人支付2000美元的承诺并没有使不可追讨的债务得以恢复——也就是说，债权人向债务人追讨2000美元的诉讼仍将因适用的诉讼时效届满而被禁止。

教学目的： 第三方受益人是指从合同中获得某种好处或利益的非合同方。但只有意定受益人才拥有合同权利，并可以提起诉讼以强制执行这些权利。

References


  • 17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 426 (2020) (intended versus incidental beneficiaries).

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

MBE 考点解析：第三方受益人

本题考察的是合同法中关于第三方受益人 (Third-Party Beneficiaries) 的权利，特别是当原债务已过诉讼时效时，新合同的效力问题。

1. 法律关系图解

债务人 (Debtor)
↓ 卖车 (Promisee)
买方 (Buyer)
↓ 承诺付款 $2,000 (Promisor)
债权人 (Creditor)
(意定受益人 Intended Beneficiary)

2. 核心考点：意定受益人

规则：如果合同双方（承诺人和受诺人）意图通过合同直接使第三方受益，该第三方即为意定受益人 (Intended Beneficiary)，有权直接起诉承诺人强制执行合同。

在本案中：

  • 承诺人 (Promisor)：买方（承诺支付钱款）。
  • 受诺人 (Promisee)：债务人（转让汽车作为对价）。
  • 受益人：债权人。
合同明确规定买方支付款项是为了“清偿债务人对债权人的债务”。这种明确的意图使得债权人成为债权受益人 (Creditor Beneficiary)，属于意定受益人的一种，因此拥有强制执行权 (Right to Enforce)。

3. 难点突破：诉讼时效 (Statute of Limitations)

本题最大的干扰项在于“原债务已过诉讼时效”。

关键逻辑：买方支付给债权人的义务，源于买方与债务人之间新的买卖合同，而不是源于旧的债务。

  • 新合同的对价 (Consideration)：买方承诺付款是因为他从债务人那里得到了一辆汽车。这与旧债务是否可执行无关。
  • 抗辩权的限制：虽然承诺人（买方）可以基于新合同向受益人主张抗辩（例如：债务人没交车），但他不能主张受诺人（债务人）对受益人（债权人）的个人抗辩（如诉讼时效）。

只要买方收到了车，他就必须按合同约定付款。至于债务人为什么要让买方把钱给债权人（即使法律上他已不必还钱），这是债务人的自由（可能是出于道德义务），不影响新合同的效力。

4. 选项解析

  • 选项 C (正确)：买方的承诺是独立的、有对价支持的合同义务。无论债务人是否在法律上必须还钱，买方都必须履行其“向债权人付款”的合同承诺。
  • 选项 A (错误)：公共政策禁止的是强制执行“过期债务”，但不禁止债务人自愿偿还，更不禁止债务人通过新合同指示第三方付款。
  • 选项 B (错误)：虽然受益人的权利受制于合同抗辩（如买方未收到车），但本题中没有事实表明买方对债务人有任何抗辩理由。
  • 选项 D (错误)：这并不是“旧债务的复活 (Revival)”。复活通常指债务人自己重新承诺还款。这里是基于一个全新的、有对价的合同产生的新义务。

5. 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 合同法题目中，看到 A 与 B 订立合同，约定 B 向 C 付款 的结构时：
  1. 首先确定 C 是意定受益人。
  2. 寻找 B (承诺人) 是否有不履行的抗辩理由（通常是 A 没履行义务）。
  3. 如果 A 已经履行了义务（如本题中交付了汽车），B 必须向 C 付款，忽略 A 与 C 之间原本关系的瑕疵（如时效已过、债务无效等）。

An expert in installing equipment on top of tall buildings contracted in a signed writing to lift and emplace certain air-conditioning equipment on top of a building. An exculpatory clause in the contract provided that the expert would not be liable for any physical damage to the building occurring during installation of the air-conditioning equipment. There was also a clause providing for per diem damages if the expert did not complete performance by a specified date and a clause providing that "time is of the essence." Another clause provided that any subsequent agreement for extra work under the contract must be in writing and signed by both parties.
With ample time remaining under the contract for commencement and completion of his performance, the expert notified the owner of the building that he was selling his business to a contractor, who was equally an expert in installing equipment on top of tall buildings, and that the contractor had agreed to "take over the contract."
The owner orally agreed with the expert to accept the contractor's services. The contractor performed on time but negligently installed the wrong air-conditioning equipment.
Will the owner succeed in an action against the expert for damages for breach of contract?

choices.a: No, because by accepting the substitution of the contractor for the expert, the owner effected a novation, and the expert was thereby discharged of his duties under the contract.
choices.b: No, because the liquidated-damage clause in the contract provided only for damages caused by delay in performance.
choices.c: Yes, because the owner did not agree to release the expert from liability under the contract.
choices.d: Yes, because the owner received no consideration for the substitution of the contractor for the expert.

There was also a clause providing for per diem damages if the expert did not complete performance by a specified date and a clause providing that "time is of the essence." Another clause provided that any subsequent agreement for extra work under the contract must be in writing and signed by both parties.

With ample time remaining under the contract for commencement and completion of his performance, the expert notified the owner of the building that he was selling his business to a contractor, who was equally an expert in installing equipment on top of tall buildings, and that the contractor had agreed to "take over the contract."

The owner orally agreed with the expert to accept the contractor's services. The contractor performed on time but negligently installed the wrong air-conditioning equipment.

Will the owner succeed in an action against the expert for damages for breach of contract?

一名在摩天大楼楼顶安装设备的专家，在一份签署的书面合同中，承诺吊装并安放特定空调设备至一栋大楼的楼顶。合同中的一项免责条款规定，该专家对在空调设备安装过程中对建筑物造成的任何物理损坏不承担责任。合同中还有一项条款，规定如果专家未能在指定日期前完成履约，将按日计算损害赔偿金，并有一项条款规定“时间至关重要”。另一项条款规定，合同项下任何后续的额外工作协议必须以书面形式并由双方签署。

在合同规定的履约开始和完成时间尚有充裕的情况下，该专家通知大楼业主，他正在将自己的业务出售给一名承包商，该承包商同样是摩天大楼楼顶设备安装的专家，并且该承包商已同意“接管合同”。

业主口头同意了专家提出的接受该承包商服务的建议。该承包商按时履约，但因过失安装了错误的空调设备。

业主以违约为由对该专家提起的损害赔偿诉讼能否胜诉？
options:
A. No, because by accepting the substitution of the contractor for the expert, the owner effected a novation, and the expert was thereby discharged of his duties under the contract.
不会，因为业主接受以承包商替代专家，构成了一次合同更新(novation)，因此专家在合同项下的义务被免除。

B. No, because the liquidated-damage clause in the contract provided only for damages caused by delay in performance.
不会，因为合同中的约定损害赔偿条款仅规定了因延迟履约所造成的损害赔偿。

C. Yes, because the owner did not agree to release the expert from liability under the contract.
会，因为业主并未同意免除专家在合同项下的责任。

D. Yes, because the owner received no consideration for the substitution of the contractor for the expert.
会，因为就业主接受以承包商替代专家一事，业主没有收到对价(consideration)。
data.explanation:
Nondelegable contractual duties Delegation not permitted when:

other contracting party has substantial interest in having delegating party perform (eg, in personal-services contract involving taste or special skill) or delegation is prohibited by contract

Obligations under a contract can generally be delegated unless :
  • the other party to the contract has a substantial interest in having the delegating party perform (eg, in a personal-services contract involving taste or a special skill) or
  • the delegation is prohibited by the contract (eg, states that "this contract may not be assigned").
However, a party may consent to a delegation that would otherwise be prohibited. After a successful delegation, the delegator remains liable under the contract unless the other party agreed to release the delegator and substitute a new one (ie, agreed to a novation).

Here, the building owner likely had a substantial interest in having the expert perform the contract - especially since the installation of the air- conditioning equipment required special skills. As a result, the expert could not delegate his duties to the contractor without the owner's consent. And although the owner consented, the owner did not agree to release the expert from liability under the contract. Therefore, the owner can sue the expert for damages caused by the contractor's negligent installation of the air-conditioning equipment.

(Choice A) A novation is a substituted contract in which the parties agree to replace an original contracting party with a new party. But merely consenting to a delegation (as seen here) does not create a novation.

(Choice B) The liquidated-damage clause in the contract provided only for damages caused by delay in performance. It does not preclude recovery for damages caused by other breaches (eg, negligent installation).

(Choice D) The building owner's consent to the delegation did not need to be supported by consideration to be valid, so this is not a basis for the owner to succeed. Instead, the owner will succeed because the owner did not release the expert from liability under the contract.

Educational objective: After a delegation (ie, transfer of contractual duties), the delegating party remains liable under the contract unless the other party agreed to release the delegating party and substitute a new one (ie, agreed to a novation).

不可转委托的合同义务 在以下情况下不允许转委托：

合同另一方在要求转委托方履行方面有重大利益（例如，在涉及个人品味或特殊技能的个人服务合同中）或 合同禁止转委托

合同项下的义务通常可以被转委托，除非：
  • 合同另一方在要求转委托方履行方面有重大利益（例如，在涉及个人品味或特殊技能的个人服务合同中）或
  • 合同禁止转委托（例如，合同声明“本合同不得转让”）。
然而，一方可以同意一项在其他情况下本应被禁止的转委托。在成功转委托后，转委托人在合同项下仍然承担责任，除非另一方同意免除转委托人的责任并替换为新的当事人（即同意合同更新 novation）。

在本案中，大楼业主很可能在要求专家履行合同方面有重大利益——特别是因为空调设备的安装需要特殊技能。因此，未经业主同意，该专家不能将其义务转委托给承包商。并且，尽管业主同意了，但业主并没同意免除专家在合同项下的责任。因此，业主可以就承包商因过失安装空调设备所造成的损害起诉该专家。

（选项A）合同更新(novation)是一种替代合同，其中各方同意用一个新的当事人替换原合同当事人。但仅仅同意转委托（如本案所示）并不构成合同更新。

（选项B）合同中的约定损害赔偿条款仅规定了因延迟履约造成的损害赔偿。它并不排除对因其他违约行为（如过失安装）造成的损害进行索赔。

（选项D）大楼业主对转委托的同意无需有对价(consideration)支持其有效性，因此这不是业主胜诉的依据。相反，业主将胜诉是因为业主没有免除专家在合同项下的责任。

教学目的：在义务转委托（即合同义务的转移）之后，转委托方在合同项下仍然承担责任，除非另一方同意免除转委托方的责任并用新的当事人替代（即同意合同更新 novation）。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 318 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (delegation of duties).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Delegation & Novation

核心考点：义务转委托 (Delegation)

本题考察的是合同法中关于义务转委托后的责任承担问题。核心规则如下：

一般规则：
当合同一方（Delegator）将其义务转委托给第三方（Delegatee）时，原合同方仍然对另一方（Obligee）承担责任。

除非发生了合同更新 (Novation)，否则仅仅通知对方或获得对方对转委托的同意，并不能免除原合同方的责任。

本案分析
专家 (Expert) 有义务安装空调
⬇️
专家将义务转给承包商 (Delegation)
⬇️
业主同意承包商干活 (Consent)
⚠️ 关键点 ⚠️
业主没有明确免除专家的责任

虽然业主口头同意接受承包商的服务，但这仅是对转委托 (Delegation) 的同意，而非对免责 (Release) 的同意。

因此，专家作为原合同义务人，对承包商的违约行为（安装了错误的设备）仍需承担连带责任。

结论： 业主可以起诉专家。正确答案是 C。

易错项辨析

选项 A 错误 (Novation)：

这是最强的干扰项。Novation (合同更新) 需要三个要素：

  1. 之前的合同有效；
  2. 所有当事人同意新合同；
  3. 明确免除 (Release) 原当事人的义务。

本题中，业主只是同意让承包商来干活（Acceptance of performance），并没有说“我不再追究专家的责任了”。没有 Release，就没有 Novation。

选项 B 错误 (Liquidated Damages)：

合同中的约定违约金条款 (Liquidated Damages Clause) 仅针对“延迟履约” (Delay)。本案的违约形式是“安装了错误的设备” (Defective Performance)，属于不同类型的违约，因此不受该条款限制。

选项 D 错误 (Consideration)：

业主同意转委托不需要额外的对价 (Consideration)。即使没有对价，业主同意后也不能再以“禁止转委托”为由拒绝承包商履约，但这并不影响专家继续承担责任。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在 MBE 合同法题目中，看到一方将工作交给另一方做（Delegation）：

  • 默认假设：原合同方依然承担责任 (Liable)。
  • 只有当题目明确出现 "Release" (免除)、"Discharge" (解除) 或 "Novation" (更新) 等字眼时，原合同方才退场。
  • 仅仅是 "Consented to the substitution" (同意替换) 通常不足以构成 Novation。

A debtor's $1,000 contractual obligation to the aunt was due on July 1. On the preceding June 15, the aunt called her niece and said, "As my birthday gift to you, you may collect on July 1 the $1,000 the debtor owes me." The aunt also called the debtor and told him to pay the $1,000 to her niece on July 1. On July 1, the debtor, saying that he did not like the niece and wouldn't pay anything to her, paid the $1,000 to the aunt, who accepted it without objection.
Will the niece succeed in an action for $1,000 against the debtor?

choices.a: No, because the aunt's acceptance of the $1,000, without objection, was in effect the revocation of a gratuitous assignment.
choices.b: No, because the debtor cannot be compelled to render performance to an assignee whom he finds personally objectionable.
choices.c: Yes, because the aunt had effectively assigned the $1,000 debt to her.
choices.d: Yes, because the aunt's calls to the niece and the debtor effected a novation.

一名债务人对姑母负有的1000美元合同义务将于7月1日到期。在之前的6月15日，姑母打电话给她的侄女说：“作为给你的生日礼物，你可以在7月1日收取债务人欠我的那1000美元。”姑母也打电话给债务人，告诉他在7月1日将1000美元支付给她的侄女。7月1日，债务人声称他不喜欢这位侄女，不会付给她任何钱，于是将1000美元支付给了姑母，姑母无异议地接受了这笔款项。

侄女对债务人提起诉讼，要求其支付1000美元，她会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the aunt's acceptance of the $1,000, without objection, was in effect the revocation of a gratuitous assignment.
不会，因为姑母无异议地接受1000美元，实际上是撤销了一项无偿的权利转让。

B. No, because the debtor cannot be compelled to render performance to an assignee whom he finds personally objectionable.
不会，因为不能强迫债务人向其个人反感的权利受让人履行义务。

C. Yes, because the aunt had effectively assigned the $1,000 debt to her.
会，因为姑母已经有效地将1000美元的债权转让给了她。

D. Yes, because the aunt's calls to the niece and the debtor effected a novation.
会，因为姑母给侄女和债务人打电话的行为构成了一项债务更新（novation）。
data.explanation:
Assignment of contractual rights


LimitationsAssignment permitted unless it:
  • materially increases obligor's contractual duties or risks
  • materially reduces obligor's chance of obtaining performance or
  • is void (not merely prohibited) under contract provision
Requirements
  • Present intent to immediately assign right
  • Consideration generally required to make assignment irrevocable

    Exceptions: promissory estoppel, delivery of document symbolizing assigned right (eg, stock certificate), delivery of written & signed assignment
Assignee's rights
  • Assumes all of assignor's rights as contract stands at time of assignment, subject to claims/defenses that:
    • accrued before obligor received notice of assignment or
    • stem from assignor's present or future failure to perform
  • Assignor loses rights & therefore cannot enforce contract

An assignment is the transfer of rights under a contract to a third party. A gratuitous assignment - ie, one that is not supported by consideration such as money - can generally be revoked by words or conduct.

Here, the aunt transferred her right to collect the $1,000 debt to her niece. The assignment was gratuitous because it was a birthday gift to the niece and the aunt asked for nothing in return. However, the debtor paid the $1,000 to the aunt - not the niece. By accepting the $1,000 without objection, the aunt effectively revoked the gratuitous assignment to the niece (Choice A). Therefore, the niece will not succeed in an action against the debtor.

(Choice B) There is no rule that excuses a party from rendering performance to an assignee whom the party finds personally objectionable.

(Choice D) A novation is a substitute contract in which the parties agree to replace an original contracting party with a new party. But here, the debtor never agreed to replace the aunt with the niece (no novation).

Educational objective: An assignment (ie, transfer of contractual rights) that is not supported by consideration can be revoked by words or conduct.

合同权利的转让


限制条件允许转让，除非该转让：
  • 实质性地增加了义务人的合同义务或风险
  • 实质性地减少了义务人获得履行的机会 或
  • 根据合同条款是无效的（而不仅仅是被禁止的）
要件
  • 具有立即转让权利的当前意图
  • 通常需要对价（consideration）才能使转让不可撤销

    例外情况：允诺禁反言（promissory estoppel）、交付象征所转让权利的文件（如股票证书）、交付书面且已签署的转让文件
受让人的权利
  • 承继转让人在转让时合同项下的所有权利，但须受制于以下抗辩/主张：
    • 在义务人收到转让通知前已经产生的 或
    • 源于转让人当前或未来的不履行
  • 转让人丧失权利，因此不能执行合同

权利转让（assignment）是指将合同项下的权利转移给第三方。一项无偿转让——即没有对价（consideration）（如金钱）支持的转让——通常可以通过言语或行为撤销。

在本案中，姑母将其收取1000美元债务的权利转让给了她的侄女。该转让是无偿的，因为它是给侄女的生日礼物，姑母没有要求任何回报。然而，债务人将1000美元支付给了姑母，而不是侄女。通过无异议地接受这1000美元，姑母实际上撤销了对侄女的无偿转让（选项A）。因此，侄女对债务人提起的诉讼将不会胜诉。

（选项B）没有任何规则允许一方因个人反感某位权利受让人而免除向其履约的义务。

（选项D）债务更新（novation）是一种替代合同，其中各方同意用一个新的当事人取代原合同当事人。但在本案中，债务人从未同意用侄女取代姑母（因此没有债务更新）。

教学目的：一项没有对价（consideration）支持的权利转让（即合同权利的转移）可以通过言语或行为来撤销。



References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 321 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (assignment of future rights).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Assignment of Rights
⚖️ 核心考点：无偿转让的可撤销性

本题考察的是无偿转让 (Gratuitous Assignment) 的法律效力。与有对价支持的转让不同，无偿转让通常是可撤销的 (Revocable)。

法律规则 (The Rule)

一项权利转让 (Assignment) 如果没有对价 (Consideration) 支持，即为“无偿转让”。

如何撤销无偿转让？
转让人 (Assignor) 可以通过以下方式撤销：

  • 随后的撤销通知；
  • 随后将同一权利转让给他人；
  • 直接接受义务人 (Obligor) 的履行 (Performance)。
本案分析 (Application)
第一步：转让
姑母 (Assignor) 将 $1000 债权作为生日礼物送给侄女 (Assignee)。
(无对价 = Gratuitous Assignment)
↓
第二步：侄女的权利
侄女原本拥有向债务人追偿的权利。
↓
第三步：撤销 (Revocation)
债务人直接付钱给姑母，姑母无异议接受了。
姑母接受履行的行为，撤销了之前的赠与。

因为姑母接受了债务人的付款，这在法律上构成了对之前无偿转让的撤销。权利回归到姑母手中并立即得到满足。因此，侄女不再拥有该债权，无法胜诉。

为什么其他选项是错的？

❌ 选项 B (Personal Objection):
合同法中，金钱债务的支付通常不涉及个人技能或信任（Personal Service），因此债务人不能因为“不喜欢”受让人而拒绝履行。

❌ 选项 D (Novation):
Novation (债务更新) 需要三方（原债权人、新债权人、债务人）达成一致协议，同意用新合同取代旧合同。本题中，债务人明确表示拒绝付钱给侄女，显然没有达成 Novation 的合意。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到 "Gift" (礼物) 字眼时，立即警惕：这是无偿转让。

接着检查是否有不可撤销 (Irrevocable) 的例外情况：
1. 是否有书面交付凭证 (如股票证书)？
2. 受让人是否产生了信赖利益 (Promissory Estoppel)？
3. 债务人是否已经向受让人履行了义务？

如果没有上述例外，转让人随时可以通过拿回钱款来撤销转让。

就针对该保洁服务公司的违约索赔而言，下列哪项陈述最为准确？
options:
A. The janitorial service is liable to the patient as a matter of public policy, because it violated the city's health code.

A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. There are two types of third- party beneficiaries:
  • Intended - who receive a direct benefit from the contract because the contracting parties so intended (eg, the contract provides that payment will go directly to a third party)
  • Incidental - who receive some indirect benefit from the contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them (ie, all third-party beneficiaries who are not intended beneficiaries)
Only intended beneficiaries - not incidental beneficiaries - have contractual rights and may sue to enforce them.

Here, the patient is an incidental beneficiary to the janitorial service - hospital contract because there is no indication that the parties intended for the contract to directly benefit the patient (Choice D). Instead, the contract was designed for all patients to indirectly benefit from hygienic rooms. Therefore, the patient has no claim for breach of contract against the janitorial service.†

†The patient may, however, have a tort claim against the janitorial service.

(Choice A) A contractual party's violation of public policy may render that contract unenforceable, but it does not provide a nonparty with the right to sue under that contract.

(Choice B) The patient could have sued on the contract had she been a named or unnamed intended beneficiary.

Educational objective: Intended beneficiaries receive a direct benefit from a contract because the contracting parties so intended, while incidental beneficiaries receive an indirect benefit from a contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them. Only intended (not incidental) beneficiaries can sue to enforce the contract.

第三方受益人是指从合同中获得某种利益或好处的非合同方。第三方受益人分为两类：
  • 意定受益人 - 他们从合同中获得直接利益，因为合同双方当事人意图如此（例如，合同规定将直接向第三方付款）
  • 附带受益人 - 他们从合同中获得某些间接利益，尽管没有使他们受益的合同意图（即，所有非意定受益人的第三方受益人）
只有意定受益人——而非附带受益人——才拥有合同权利，并可以提起诉讼以强制执行这些权利。

在本案中，该患者是保洁服务公司与医院之间合同的附带受益人，因为没有迹象表明双方当事人意图让合同直接使该患者受益（选项D）。相反，该合同旨在让所有患者从卫生的房间中间接受益。因此，该患者对该保洁服务公司没有违约索赔权。†

†但是，该患者可能对该保洁服务公司有侵权索赔权。

（选项A）合同一方违反公共政策可能导致该合同不可强制执行，但这并不赋予非合同方根据该合同提起诉讼的权利。

（选项B）如果该患者是具名或不具名的意定受益人，她本可以根据该合同提起诉讼。

教学目的：意定受益人从合同中获得直接利益，因为合同双方当事人意图如此；而附带受益人从合同中获得间接利益，尽管没有使他们受益的合同意图。只有意定受益人（而非附带受益人）才能提起诉讼以强制执行合同。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 315 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (no right to enforce for incidental beneficiaries).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Third-Party Rights
核心考点：第三方受益人 在合同法中，非合同当事人（Nonparty）能否起诉违约，取决于其身份：
  • 意定受益人 (Intended Beneficiary)：
    合同双方意图赋予其直接利益和执行权。只有这类人有权起诉。
  • 附带受益人 (Incidental Beneficiary)：
    虽然从合同中受益，但并非合同的主要目的。这类人无权起诉。
本案逻辑分析

本题的关键在于判断患者（Patient）在保洁公司（Janitorial Service）与医院（Hospital）的合同中处于什么地位。

合同方 A：保洁公司
↕️ 签订合同
合同方 B：医院
⬇️ 间接好处
第三方：患者
(附带受益人 - 无权起诉)

虽然清洁服务确实让患者受益（环境更卫生），但合同的主要目的是为了医院的运营合规和商业需求。除非合同中有明确条款表明双方意图赋予患者直接的法律追索权，否则在法律上，患者仅被视为Incidental Beneficiary。

因此，患者不能基于合同关系（Breach of Contract）起诉保洁公司。

选项深度解析
选项 C (正确答案)
患者是附带受益人，无权索赔。
这符合 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 的规则。由于缺乏赋予患者执行权的意图，她无法强制执行合同。
选项 D (常见干扰项)
错误原因：混淆了“受益”与“意定”。
虽然保洁是为了让所有患者受益（广义上），但在法律上，这不足以构成“意定受益人”。大多数涉及政府或公共服务（如医院、市政工程）的合同，公众成员通常都被视为附带受益人，除非合同另有明确规定。
选项 A (陷阱项)
错误原因：混淆了侵权与合同。
违反卫生法规（Public Policy/Health Code）可能支持侵权（Tort/Negligence）诉讼，但这并不会自动创造合同（Contract）下的起诉权。题目明确问的是“违约索赔”（Breach of contract claim）。
选项 B (错误理由)
错误原因：理由不充分。
未被“指名道姓”（Named）并不是不能起诉的绝对理由。如果合同说“为所有周二住院的患者提供服务”，这类未具名的群体（Class）如果是意定受益人，也可以起诉。患者不能起诉的根本原因是缺乏“意图”，而不是因为没写名字。
💡 MBE 提分技巧：
注意区分侵权（Tort）和合同（Contract）的责任基础。

本题中，患者很可能因为保洁公司的疏忽（Negligence）赢得侵权诉讼。但题目限定了问“违约索赔”。在合同法考题中，不要因为被告“做错了事”就想当然地认为原告在合同法上有权胜诉。

A political candidate for a statewide office contracted with a songwriter to compose a theme song for his campaign for $10,000. The contract provided that, rather than paying the songwriter, the candidate was to pay the money to the songwriter's daughter. The contract also prohibited the assignment of any rights or duties arising under the contract without the permission of the other party. Subsequently, the daughter, upon learning of the contract from her father, decided to donate this money to a charity and transferred her rights under the contract to the charity. She did not secure the permission of the political candidate before making this transfer. The songwriter composed the song, which the candidate used in his campaign, but the candidate did not pay anyone for the song. The charity filed suit against the candidate for breach of contract. The charity has taken no other action and has incurred no expenses related to the contract.
Will the charity prevail in its action against the candidate?

choices.a: No, because the charity has not detrimentally relied on the candidate's promise.
choices.b: No, because the contract prohibits assignments.
choices.c: Yes, because the charity is the assignee of the daughter's contractual rights.
choices.d: Yes, because the charity is the donee beneficiary of the contract.

questions.question:
A patient owed a physician $25,000 for professional services. The physician orally assigned this claim to her adult daughter as a wedding gift. Shortly thereafter, on suffering sudden, severe losses in the stock market, the physician assigned by a signed writing the same claim to her stockbroker in partial satisfaction of advances legally made by the stockbroker in the physician's previous stock-market transactions. Subsequently, the patient, without knowledge of either assignment, paid the physician the $25,000 then due, which the physician promptly lost at a horse track. The physician remains solvent.
Assume that Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code does NOT apply to either of the assignments in this situation.
Which of the following is a correct statement of the parties' rights and liabilities?

choices.a: As the assignee prior in time, the daughter can recover $25,000 from the patient, who acted at her peril in paying the physician.
choices.b: As the sole assignee for value, the stockbroker can recover $25,000 from the patient, who acted at her peril in paying the physician.
choices.c: Neither the daughter nor the stockbroker can recover from the patient, but the daughter, though not the stockbroker, can recover $25,000 from the physician.
choices.d: Neither the daughter nor the stockbroker can recover from the patient, but the stockbroker, though not the daughter, can recover $25,000 from the physician.

Assume that Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code does NOT apply to either of the assignments in this situation.

Which of the following is a correct statement of the parties' rights and liabilities?

一名病人因专业服务欠一位医生25,000美元。该医生将这项债权作为结婚礼物，口头转让给了她的成年女儿。此后不久，由于在股市中遭受突发的严重损失，该医生通过一份签署的书面文件，将同一项债权转让给了她的股票经纪人，以部分清偿该股票经纪人在医生之前的股票市场交易中合法垫付的款项。随后，该病人在对两次转让均不知情的情况下，向医生支付了到期的25,000美元，而医生随即在赛马场将这笔钱输光了。该医生仍有偿付能力。

假设Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code不适用于本案中的任何一项转让。

以下哪项是关于各方权利和义务的正确陈述？
options:
A. As the assignee prior in time, the daughter can recover $25,000 from the patient, who acted at her peril in paying the physician.
作为在先的受让人，女儿可以向病人追讨25,000美元，后者向医生付款的行为属于自担风险。

B. As the sole assignee for value, the stockbroker can recover $25,000 from the patient, who acted at her peril in paying the physician.
作为唯一的有对价受让人，股票经纪人可以向病人追讨25,000美元，后者向医生付款的行为属于自担风险。

C. Neither the daughter nor the stockbroker can recover from the patient, but the daughter, though not the stockbroker, can recover $25,000 from the physician.
女儿和股票经纪人都不能向病人追讨，但女儿（而非股票经纪人）可以向医生追讨25,000美元。

D. Neither the daughter nor the stockbroker can recover from the patient, but the stockbroker, though not the daughter, can recover $25,000 from the physician.
女儿和股票经纪人都不能向病人追讨，但股票经纪人（而非女儿）可以向医生追讨25,000美元。

Assignment of contractual rights


TypeRevocabilityWarranties
GratuitousRevocable unless:
  • obligor already performed
  • document symbolizing assigned right (eg, stock certificate) delivered
  • written & signed assignment delivered
  • promissory estoppel applies
None
For valueIrrevocableAssignor warrants that he/she:
  • has right to assign
  • is not subject to limitations/defenses unknown to assignee
  • will not defeat/impair assigned rights
An assignment is the transfer of a contractual right to another. Where there has been a subsequent assignment of the same right, the priority of those competing assignments depends on whether the first assignment was:
  • revocable - in which case, the first assignment is automatically revoked and the second assignment has priority or
  • irrevocable - in which case, the first assignment has priority unless the second assignee was a bona fide purchaser for value who lacked notice of the first assignment.


Here, the physician orally assigned her claim for the $25,000 owed by the patient to her daughter as a wedding gift. That oral assignment was valid.† However, it was revocable because it was gratuitous and no exception applies (see above table). This means that the assignment to the daughter was automatically revoked when the physician subsequently assigned the same claim to her stockbroker. Accordingly, the daughter has no right to the $25,000 (Choices A & C).

The physician's assignment to the stockbroker was for value (namely, in partial satisfaction of advances), so it was irrevocable. Every assignment for value carries an implied warranty that the assignor will not do anything to defeat or impair the assigned right. The physician breached that warranty by accepting the $25,000 owed by the patient and losing it at the horse track. As a result, the stockbroker can recover $25,000 from the physician.

However, the stockbroker cannot recover that amount from the patient. The reason is that the assignee's rights against the obligor are subject to any defenses that the obligor had against the assignor. Payment by the obligor (patient) to the assignor (physician) can be raised as a defense, provided that the payment was made before the obligor had notice of the assignment (as seen here). Therefore, the patient did not act at her peril in paying the physician (Choice B).

†Oral assignments are generally valid. However, a writing is required for (1) wage assignments, (2) assignments of interests in land, and (3) assignments intended as security instruments under Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code - none of which apply here.

Educational objective: A subsequent assignment of the same right revokes any prior revocable assignment. If the first assignment was irrevocable, it has priority unless the second assignee was a bona fide purchaser for value who lacked notice.

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 6%，C选项 8%，D选项 82%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

合同权利的转让


类型可撤销性担保
无偿（赠与性）转让可撤销，除非：
  • 债务人已履行
  • 象征所转让权利的文件（如股票）已交付
  • 书面且签署的转让文件已交付
  • 适用允诺禁反言原则
无
有对价转让不可撤销转让人担保其：
  • 有权转让
  • 不受受让人所不知的限制或抗辩的约束
  • 不会挫败或损害被转让的权利
转让是指将合同权利转移给他人。当同一权利被后续转让时，这些相冲突的转让的优先顺序取决于第一次转让是：
  • 可撤销的 - 在这种情况下，第一次转让将自动被撤销，第二次转让具有优先权 或
  • 不可撤销的 - 在这种情况下，第一次转让具有优先权，除非第二个受让人是善意有对价购买人且对第一次转让不知情。


在本案中，医生将其对病人所欠的25,000美元的债权作为结婚礼物口头转让给了她的女儿。该口头转让是有效的。† 然而，由于它是无偿的（赠与性的）且没有例外情况适用（见上表），因此是可撤销的。这意味着，当医生随后将同一债权转让给她的股票经纪人时，对女儿的转让被自动撤销了。因此，女儿对这25,000美元没有权利 （选项 A & C）。

医生向股票经纪人的转让是有对价的（即，为了部分清偿垫付款项），因此是不可撤销的。每一次有对价的转让都带有一项默示担保，即转让人不会做出任何挫败或损害被转让权利的行为。医生接受了病人所欠的25,000美元并将其在赛马场输掉，从而违反了该担保。因此，股票经纪人可以向医生追讨25,000美元。

然而，股票经纪人不能向病人追讨该款项。原因是受让人对债务人的权利，受制于债务人可以向转让人主张的任何抗辩。债务人（病人）向转让人（医生）的付款可以作为一项抗辩提出，前提是该付款是在债务人收到转让通知之前作出的（如本案所示）。因此，病人向医生付款的行为并非自担风险 （选项 B）。

†口头转让通常是有效的。但是，对于（1）工资转让、（2）土地权益转让，以及（3）根据Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code意图作为担保工具的转让，则需要书面形式——这些情况均不适用于本案。

教学目的： 对同一权利的后续转让会撤销任何先前的可撤销转让。如果第一次转让是不可撤销的，则其具有优先权，除非第二个受让人是善意有对价购买人且不知情。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 342 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (subsequent assignment of same right).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Assignment of Rights

案情时间线 Fact Pattern

1. 第一次转让 (To Daughter) 口头 (Oral)、无偿 (Gift)。
2. 第二次转让 (To Stockbroker) 书面 (Written)、有对价 (For Value)。
3. 病人付款 (Payment) 病人不知情，付给了医生 (Assignor)。
4. 结果 医生把钱输光了。

考点一：转让的优先权 Priority

本案涉及对同一债权的两次转让（Successive Assignments）。

  • 第一次转让（给女儿）：是无偿的（Gratuitous）。
    规则：无偿转让通常是可撤销的 (Revocable)。
  • 第二次转让（给经纪人）：是有对价的（For Value）。
    规则：后续转让同一权利，会自动撤销 (Revoke) 之前的可撤销转让。
结论： 女儿的权利被撤销，股票经纪人是唯一的有效债权人。

考点二：债务人的抗辩 Obligor's Defense

股票经纪人能否向病人（Patient）追讨？

规则： 如果债务人（Obligor）在收到转让通知（Notice of Assignment）之前，已经向原债权人（Assignor）履行了债务，该履行有效。

本案中，病人对转让不知情，且已向医生全额付款。

结论： 病人的债务已清偿。股票经纪人不能向病人追讨。

考点三：转让人的担保 Warranties

股票经纪人能否向医生（Physician）追讨？

规则： 在有对价的转让中，转让人（Assignor）向受让人（Assignee）提供默示担保 (Implied Warranty)，保证其不会做出任何损害或挫败受让人权利的行为。

医生接受病人的付款并挥霍掉，违反了该担保。

结论： 股票经纪人可以向医生追讨 $25,000。

选项分析

A 错误：女儿的权利已被第二次转让撤销，她无权追讨。
B 错误：虽然经纪人是有效受让人，但病人因“不知情付款”而免责，不需要自担风险 (Not at peril)。
C 错误：女儿的权利已被撤销，她对医生也没有追索权（赠与通常无担保）。
D 正确：经纪人不能找病人（因病人已善意付款），但可以找医生（因医生违反了转让担保）。
正确答案：D

Exam Tip: 遇到多重转让题，先看第一次转让是否“可撤销”（通常看是否无偿）。如果是可撤销的，后续转让通常会将其覆盖。

questions.question:
An orchard contracted with a cannery to provide the cannery with peaches. The contract was silent regarding delegation, and the orchard, acting in good faith, delegated its duties under the contract to a third party. After asking for, and receiving, assurances from the third party that the peaches would conform to contract specifications, the cannery accepted the delegation. The third party delivered the peaches, which the cannery rejected because the peaches did not conform to the contract specifications. The cannery sued both the orchard and the third party. The orchard moved to dismiss the claims against it.
Should the court dismiss the suit against the orchard?

choices.a: No, because the contract did not specifically allow for the delegation of duties.
choices.b: No, because the delegation of its duties did not absolve the orchard of its contractual liability.
choices.c: Yes, because the cannery accepted the delegation.
choices.d: Yes, because the orchard delegated its contractual duties in good faith.

questions.question:
A famous musician entered into a written agreement with an interior decorator, who was well known for his avant-garde designs, to design and decorate the musician's recording studio. The agreement was silent as to assignment or delegation by either party.
Before beginning the work, the interior decorator sold his decorating business to a man under an agreement in which the interior decorator assigned to the man, and the man agreed to complete, the recording-studio contract. The man, a world-renowned decorator of excellent repute, advised the musician of the assignment, and supplied her with information confirming his financial responsibility and past commercial success all over the world.
If the musician allows the man to perform and approves his design plan, but the man fails without legal excuse to complete the decorating as agreed, against whom does the musician have an enforceable claim for breach of contract?

choices.a: Either the first interior decorator, because his agreement with the man did not discharge his duty to the musician; or the man, because the musician was an intended beneficiary of the agreement between the first interior decorator and the man.
choices.b: The first interior decorator only, because his agreement with the man did not discharge his duty to the musician, and the man made no express promise to the musician.
choices.c: The man only, because the first interior decorator's duty to the musician was discharged when he obtained a decorator of excellent repute (the man) to perform the recording-studio contract.
choices.d: The man only, because the musician was an intended beneficiary of the agreement between the first interior decorator and the man, and the interior decorator's duty to the musician was discharged when she permitted the man to do the work and approved his design.

在开始工作前，该室内设计师通过一份协议将其装修业务出售给一名男子，根据该协议，室内设计师将录音室合同转让给该男子，该男子也同意完成该合同。该男子是一位享誉世界、声誉卓著的设计师，他将转让事宜通知了音乐家，并向她提供了证明其财务责任和过往全球商业成功的信息。

如果音乐家允许该男子履行合同并批准其设计方案，但该男子在没有法律免责事由的情况下，未能按约定完成装修，音乐家可以向谁提出可强制执行的违约索赔？
options:
A. Either the first interior decorator, because his agreement with the man did not discharge his duty to the musician; or the man, because the musician was an intended beneficiary of the agreement between the first interior decorator and the man.
可以是第一位室内设计师，因为他与该男子的协议并未免除其对音乐家的义务；也可以是该男子，因为音乐家是第一位室内设计师与该男子之间协议的意定受益人。

B. The first interior decorator only, because his agreement with the man did not discharge his duty to the musician, and the man made no express promise to the musician.
仅第一位室内设计师，因为他与该男子的协议并未免除其对音乐家的义务，且该男子未对音乐家做出任何明示承诺。

C. The man only, because the first interior decorator's duty to the musician was discharged when he obtained a decorator of excellent repute (the man) to perform the recording-studio contract.
仅该男子，因为当第一位室内设计师找到一位声誉卓著的设计师（该男子）来履行录音室合同时，其对音乐家的义务已被免除。

D. The man only, because the musician was an intended beneficiary of the agreement between the first interior decorator and the man, and the interior decorator's duty to the musician was discharged when she permitted the man to do the work and approved his design.
仅该男子，因为音乐家是第一位室内设计师与该男子之间协议的意定受益人，并且当她允许该男子进行工作并批准其设计时，室内设计师对音乐家的义务已被免除。
data.explanation:
Nondelegable contractual duties Delegation not permitted when:

other contracting party has substantial interest in having delegating party perform (eg, in personal-services contract involving taste or special skill) or delegation is prohibited by contract

Obligations under a contract can generally be delegated unless :
  • the other party to the contract has a substantial interest in having the delegating party perform (eg, in a personal-services contract involving taste or a special skill) or
  • the delegation is prohibited by the contract (eg, the contract says "this contract may not be assigned").
However, a party may consent to a delegation that would otherwise be prohibited. After a successful delegation, the delegator remains liable under the contract unless the other party agrees to a release.

Here, the famous musician had a substantial interest in having the interior decorator perform the recording-studio contract - particularly since the interior decorator was well known for his avant-garde designs. As a result, the interior decorator cannot delegate his duties to the man without the musician's consent. And even if the musician does consent, the interior decorator will not be released from liability. Therefore, if the musician consents to the delegation and the man fails to complete the job, the musician can sue the interior decorator for breach.

When, as here, a contracting party (the interior decorator) delegates his/her duties by forming a separate contract with the delegatee (the man), the other party to the original contract (the musician) becomes an intended beneficiary of that separate contract. The intended beneficiary can then sue the delegatee (in addition to the delegator) in the event of a breach. The musician, as the intended beneficiary of the agreement between the interior decorator and the man, can therefore sue the man for breach as well (Choices B, C & D).

Educational objective: Delegation of contractual obligations is permitted unless (1) the other party to the contract has a substantial interest in having the delegating party perform or (2) the delegation is prohibited by the contract. After a delegation, the delegating party remains liable under the contract unless the other party agrees to a release.

选项正确率统计：A选项 65%（正确选项），B选项 13%，C选项 3%，D选项 18%

不可委托的合同义务 在以下情况不允许委托：

合同另一方在由委托方履行合同方面有重大利益（例如，在涉及个人品味或特殊技能的个人服务合同中）或者 合同禁止委托

合同项下的义务通常可以被委托，除非：
  • 合同另一方在由委托方履行合同方面有重大利益（例如，在涉及个人品味或特殊技能的个人服务合同中）或者
  • 合同禁止委托（例如，合同规定“本合同不得转让”）。
然而，一方当事人可以同意一项在其他情况下本会被禁止的委托。委托成功后，委托人在合同项下仍需承担责任，除非另一方当事人同意免除其责任。

在本案中，著名音乐家在由该室内设计师履行录音室合同方面有重大利益——特别是因为该室内设计师以前卫设计而闻名。因此，未经音乐家同意，室内设计师不能将其义务委托给该男子。并且，即使音乐家同意，室内设计师也不会被免除责任。因此，如果音乐家同意委托，而该男子未能完成工作，音乐家可以因违约而起诉室内设计师。

在本案中，当合同一方（室内设计师）通过与受托人（该男子）订立单独合同来委托其义务时，原合同的另一方（音乐家）成为该单独合同的意定受益人。在发生违约时，意定受益人可以起诉受托人（以及委托人）。因此，音乐家作为室内设计师与该男子之间协议的意定受益人，也可以因违约而起诉该男子（因此选项 B、C 和 D 不正确）。

教学目标：合同义务的委托是允许的，除非（1）合同另一方在由委托方履行合同方面有重大利益，或（2）合同禁止委托。委托之后，委托方在合同项下仍需承担责任，除非另一方当事人同意免除其责任。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 318 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (delegation of performance of duty).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Assignment & Delegation
✅ 正确答案解析 (Option A)

音乐家既可以起诉原来的设计师（委托人），也可以起诉接手的设计师（受托人）。

这道题考察的是合同法中关于义务委托（Delegation of Duties）后的责任归属问题。

责任流向图
音乐家 (Musician)
债权人 / Obligee
⬇️ 可起诉 (Sue)
原设计师 (Decorator A)
委托人 / Delegator
➕ 且 (AND)
新设计师 (The Man)
受托人 / Delegatee
考点 1：委托不等于免责

规则： 除非债权人明确同意释放原债务人的责任（即达成 Novation，更替合同），否则原债务人（委托人）在委托义务后，仍然对合同履行承担责任。

本案分析： 虽然音乐家同意让新设计师干活（Consent to delegation），但她并没有签署协议免除原设计师的责任（No release of liability）。

👉 Delegation does not discharge the delegator.

考点 2：受托人的承诺

规则： 当受托人承诺履行原合同义务（Assumption of Duties）并以此作为对价（例如买下原设计师的生意）时，原债权人（音乐家）就成为了该协议的意定受益人 (Intended Third-Party Beneficiary)。

本案分析： 新设计师承诺完成录音室合同。因此，音乐家可以直接起诉新设计师违约。

为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 B 错： 认为只能起诉原设计师。错误，因为新设计师已经明确承诺履行义务，音乐家作为受益人有权起诉他。
  • 选项 C & D 错： 认为原设计师免责。这是MBE最常见的陷阱！“同意委托” (Consenting to delegation) 不等于 “同意免责” (Release/Novation)。 除非题目明确说 "Musician agreed to release the first decorator"，否则原设计师永远在钩子上。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在处理 Delegation（委托）题目时，请记住：

  1. 默认规则： 委托人（Delegator）始终承担责任。
  2. 例外情况： 只有看到 Novation（更替合同）或 Release（免责声明）这两个词，委托人才会退场。
  3. 受托人责任： 如果受托人承诺（Promise）去履行，他也被套牢了，债权人可以二选一或双管齐下。

On January 5, a creditor loaned $1,000 to a debtor under a contract calling for the debtor to repay the loan at the rate of $100 per month payable on the first day of each month. On February 1, at the debtor's request, the creditor agreed to permit payment on February 5. On March 1, the debtor requested a similar time extension and the creditor replied, "Don't bother me each month. Just change the date of payment to the fifth of the month. But you must now make the payments by cashier's check." The debtor said, "Okay," and made payments on March 5 and April 5 by cashier's check. On April 6, the creditor sold the loan contract to a bank but did not tell the bank about the agreement permitting payments on the fifth of the month. On April 6, the bank wrote to the debtor: "Your debt to [the creditor] has been assigned to us. We hereby inform you that all payments must be made on the first day of the month."
Can the debtor justifiably insist that the payment date for the rest of the installments is the fifth of each month?

choices.a: No, because a contract modification is not binding on an assignee who had no knowledge of the modification.
choices.b: No, because although the creditor waived the condition of payment on the first of the month, the bank reinstated it.
choices.c: Yes, because although the creditor waived the condition of payment on the first of the month, the creditor could not assign to the bank his right to reinstate that condition.
choices.d: Yes, because the creditor could assign to the bank only those rights the creditor had in the contract at the time of the assignment.

1月5日，一名债权人根据一份合同向一名债务人出借了1000美元，该合同要求债务人以每月100美元的利率偿还贷款，于每月的第一天支付。2月1日，应债务人请求，债权人同意允许于2月5日付款。3月1日，债务人请求类似的延期，债权人答复说：“别每个月都来烦我。就把付款日期改成每月的第五天吧。但你现在必须用银行本票付款。”债务人说：“好的”，并于3月5日和4月5日用银行本票付款。4月6日，债权人将贷款合同出售给一家银行，但未告知银行有关允许在每月第五天付款的协议。4月6日，银行致函债务人：“您对[债权人]的债务已转让给我们。我们在此通知您，所有款项必须在每月的第一天支付。”

债务人是否有正当理由坚持，剩余分期付款的支付日期为每月的第五天？
options:
A. No, because a contract modification is not binding on an assignee who had no knowledge of the modification.
否，因为合同变更对不知情的受让人没有约束力。

B. No, because although the creditor waived the condition of payment on the first of the month, the bank reinstated it.
否，因为虽然债权人放弃了每月第一天付款的条件，但银行恢复了该条件。

C. Yes, because although the creditor waived the condition of payment on the first of the month, the creditor could not assign to the bank his right to reinstate that condition.
是，因为虽然债权人放弃了每月第一天付款的条件，但债权人不能将其恢复该条件的权利转让给银行。

D. Yes, because the creditor could assign to the bank only those rights the creditor had in the contract at the time of the assignment.
是，因为债权人只能将其在转让时于合同中拥有的权利转让给银行。
data.explanation:
Assignment of contractual rights


LimitationsRequirementsAssignee's rights
Assignment permitted unless it:
  • materially increases obligor's contractual duties or risks
  • materially reduces obligor's chance of obtaining performance or
  • is void (not merely prohibited) under contract provision
  • Present intent to immediately assign right
  • Consideration generally required to make assignment irrevocable
  • Exceptions: promissory estoppel, delivery of document symbolizing assigned right (eg, stock certificate), delivery of written & signed assignment
  • Assumes all of assignor's rights as contract stands at time of assignment, subject to claims/defenses that:
    • accrued before obligor received notice of assignment or
    • stem from assignor's present or future failure to perform
  • Assignor loses rights & therefore cannot enforce contract
An assignment is the transfer of rights under a contract to another (ie, assignee). The assignee takes all of the rights of the assignor as the contract stands at the time of the assignment.

Here, the contract between the debtor and the creditor called for the debtor to make payments on the first day of each month. The parties effectively modified that contract when the creditor promised to accept payments on the fifth day of each month in exchange for the debtor's promise to make the payments by cashier's check.† Since this occurred before the creditor assigned his rights under the loan contract to the bank, the debtor can justifiably insist that the payment date for the rest of the installments is the fifth of each month.

†Note that there was consideration for the creditor's promise to accept payment at a later date (and the modification was effective) because the debtor altered his preexisting duty to pay the debt by promising to make future payments by cashier's check.

(Choice A) There is no rule that makes a contract modification ineffective as to an assignee simply because the assignee had no notice of it. As such, the assignee (here, the bank) is bound by the modification.

(Choices B & C) It is true that if a party waives a condition, that party may reinstate the condition with respect to future acts of performance. However, that rule is not applicable here because the parties modified the contract by mutual agreement and the opportunity to reinstate a condition was no longer available.

Educational objective: An assignee (ie, one to whom rights under a contract are transferred) takes all of the assignor's rights as the contract stands at the time of the assignment.

合同权利的转让


限制要件受让人的权利
允许转让，除非其：
  • 实质性地增加了债务人（obligor）的合同义务或风险
  • 实质性地减少了债务人获得履约的机会或
  • 根据合同条款是无效的（而不仅仅是被禁止的）
  • 立即转让权利的当前意图
  • 通常需要对价（consideration）以使转让不可撤销
  • 例外情况：promissory estoppel、交付象征所转让权利的文件（例如，股票证书）、交付书面且已签署的转让文件
  • 承接转让人在转让时合同项下的所有权利，但受制于以下主张/抗辩：
    • 在债务人收到转让通知前已经产生的或
    • 源于转让人当前或未来的不履行
  • 转让人丧失权利，因此不能执行合同
转让是指将合同项下的权利转移给另一方（即受让人）。受让人承接转让人在转让之时合同项下的所有权利。

在本案中，债务人与债权人之间的合同要求债务人在每月第一天付款。当债权人承诺接受在每月第五天付款，以换取债务人承诺用银行本票付款时，双方有效地变更了该合同。† 由于这发生在债权人将其贷款合同项下的权利转让给银行之前，因此债务人可以正当坚持，剩余分期付款的支付日期为每月的第五天。

†请注意，债权人同意在稍后日期接受付款的承诺存在对价（consideration）（因此该变更是有效的），因为债务人通过承诺未来使用银行本票付款，改变了他预先存在的偿债义务。

(选项A) 没有任何规则规定，仅因受让人不知情，合同变更就对该受让人无效。因此，受让人（在此案中为银行）受该变更的约束。

(选项B和C) 的确，如果一方当事人放弃了某个条件，该当事人可以针对未来的履约行为恢复该条件。但是，该规则不适用于本案，因为双方通过相互协议变更了合同，恢复条件的机会已不复存在。

教学目标：受让人（即合同权利的被转让方）承接转让人在转让之时合同项下的所有权利。

MBE 考点解析

合同权利转让与变更
(Assignment & Modification)
正确答案：D

是，因为债权人只能将其在转让时于合同中拥有的权利转让给银行。

⚖️ 核心法律原则

受让人的权利范围 (Rights of the Assignee)

受让人（Assignee，即银行）“穿上了转让人（Assignor，即债权人）的鞋子”。

这意味着受让人获得的权利，受制于转让发生时债务人（Obligor）对转让人拥有的所有抗辩和合同变更。

Latin maxim: Nemo dat quod non habet (No one gives what he doesn't have).

🔍 逻辑推理链条
1
合同变更 (Modification) 已发生
在转让给银行之前（3月1日），债权人和债务人达成协议：将付款日改为每月5号，条件是债务人必须使用银行本票 (Cashier's Check)。
2
存在对价 (Consideration)
这是本题的关键陷阱。仅仅改变付款时间通常需要对价。这里债务人承诺使用“银行本票”而非普通支票或现金，这构成了法律上的不利益（Legal Detriment），因此是对价。这使得该协议成为具有约束力的合同变更 (Modification)，而不仅仅是单方面的弃权 (Waiver)。
3
转让的时间点
转让发生在4月6日。此时，原合同已经被有效修改。债权人手中拥有的权利已经是“每月5号收款”的权利，而非“每月1号收款”。
4
受让人的地位
银行作为受让人，只能继承债权人在4月6日实际拥有的权利。无论银行是否知情，它都受制于之前的有效合同变更。
🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (关于通知)

错误。合同变更对受让人是否有效，取决于变更发生的时间（是否在转让前），而不是受让人是否知情。受让人不知情可能会导致其向转让人索赔（违反担保），但不影响债务人的权利。

选项 B & C (关于弃权 Waiver)

错误。这两个选项假设债权人的行为仅仅是“弃权”。

  • 弃权 (Waiver): 一方单方面放弃权利，通常可以撤回（Retract）并恢复原条款，只要给对方合理通知且对方未发生信赖利益损失。
  • 变更 (Modification): 双方达成一致且有对价，构成新合同，不能单方面恢复原条款。

因为本题中有“银行本票”作为对价，所以是不可单方撤销的变更。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

寻找“隐藏的对价”

在合同修改题中，仔细寻找一方是否承担了额外的微小义务（如本题中的“改用银行本票”）。

如果有，这就是Modification（有约束力）；如果没有，这通常只是Waiver（可撤回）。这个细微差别往往决定了选项 B/C 和 D 的生死。
