On December 1, a broker contracted with a coin collector to sell her one of a certain type of rare coin for $12,000, delivery and payment to occur on the next March 1. To fulfill that contract, and without the collector's knowledge, the broker contracted on January 1 to purchase for $10,000 a specimen of that type coin from a man, delivery and payment to occur on February 1. The market price of such coins had unexpectedly fallen to $8,000 by February 1, when the man tendered the coin and the broker repudiated.
On February 25, the market in such coins suddenly reversed and had stabilized at $12,000 on March 1. The broker, however, had failed to obtain a specimen of the coin and repudiated his agreement with the collector when she tendered the $12,000 agreed price on March 1.
Later that day, after learning by chance of the broker's dealing with the collector, the man telephoned the collector and said: "Listen, the broker probably owes me at least $2,000 in damages for refusing to buy my coin for $10,000 on February 1 when the market was down to $8,000. But I'm in good shape in view of the market's recovery since then, and I think you should sue the broker."
If the collector immediately sues the broker for his breach of the broker-man contract, which of the following will the court probably decide?

choices.a: The broker wins, because as of March 1 neither the man nor the collector had sustained any damage from the broker's repudiation of both contracts.
choices.b: The broker wins, because the collector, if a beneficiary at all of the broker-man contract, was only an incidental beneficiary.
choices.c: The collector wins, because she took an effective assignment of the man's claim for damages against the broker when the man suggested that the collector "sue the broker."
choices.d: The collector wins, because she was an intended beneficiary of the broker-man contract, under which damages for the broker's repudiation became fixed on February 1.

On December 1, a broker contracted with a coin collector to sell her one of a certain type of rare coin for $12,000, delivery and payment to occur on the next March 1. To fulfill that contract, and without the collector's knowledge, the broker contracted on January 1 to purchase for $10,000 a specimen of that type coin from a man, delivery and payment to occur on February 1. The market price of such coins had unexpectedly fallen to $8,000 by February 1, when the man tendered the coin and the broker repudiated.

On February 25, the market in such coins suddenly reversed and had stabilized at $12,000 on March 1. The broker, however, had failed to obtain a specimen of the coin and repudiated his agreement with the collector when she tendered the $12,000 agreed price on March 1.

Later that day, after learning by chance of the broker's dealing with the collector, the man telephoned the collector and said: "Listen, the broker probably owes me at least $2,000 in damages for refusing to buy my coin for $10,000 on February 1 when the market was down to $8,000. But I'm in good shape in view of the market's recovery since then, and I think you should sue the broker."

If the collector immediately sues the broker for his breach of the broker-man contract, which of the following will the court probably decide?

12月1日，一名经纪人与一位硬币收藏家签订合同，以12,000美元的价格向她出售一枚特定类型的稀有硬币，交付和付款日为次年3月1日。为履行该合同，在收藏家不知情的情况下，该经纪人于1月1日与一名男子签订合同，以10,000美元的价格购买一枚该类型的硬币，交付和付款日为2月1日。到2月1日，当该男子提交硬币而经纪人悔约时，此类硬币的市场价格出人意料地跌至8,000美元。

2月25日，此类硬币的市场行情突然逆转，并于3月1日稳定在12,000美元。然而，该经纪人未能获得一枚该类型的硬币，并在收藏家于3月1日提交了商定的12,000美元价款时，拒绝履行其与收藏家的协议。

当天晚些时候，该男子偶然得知经纪人与收藏家的交易后，致电收藏家说：“听着，经纪人因在2月1日市场价跌至8,000美元时拒绝以10,000美元购买我的硬币，可能欠我至少2,000美元的损害赔偿金。但鉴于此后市场的复苏，我的情况还不错，我认为你应该起诉那个经纪人。”

如果收藏家立即就经纪人违反其与该男子的合同而起诉经纪人，法院可能会做出以下哪项裁决？
options:
A. The broker wins, because as of March 1 neither the man nor the collector had sustained any damage from the broker's repudiation of both contracts.

B. The broker wins, because the collector, if a beneficiary at all of the broker-man contract, was only an incidental beneficiary.

C. The collector wins, because she took an effective assignment of the man's claim for damages against the broker when the man suggested that the collector "sue the broker."
收藏家胜诉，因为当该男子建议收藏家“起诉经纪人”时，她接受了该男子对经纪人的损害赔偿请求权的有效转让。

D. The collector wins, because she was an intended beneficiary of the broker-man contract, under which damages for the broker's repudiation became fixed on February 1.
收藏家胜诉，因为她是经纪人与该男子之间合同的意定受益人，根据该合同，因经纪人悔约而产生的损害赔偿金已于2月1日确定。

Third-party beneficiaries


(ie, nonparties who benefit from contract)
TypeDefinitionRight to enforce
IntendedReceive direct benefit from contract because contracting parties intended to benefit them Eg, A promises to paint B's house if B promises to pay $500 to CYes
IncidentalReceive indirect benefit from contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them Eg, A promises to buy B a car manufactured by CNo
A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. There are two types of third- party beneficiaries:
  • Intended - who receive a direct benefit from the contract because the contracting parties so intended and, therefore, have a right to enforce the contract
  • Incidental - who receive some indirect benefit from the contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them and, therefore, have no right to enforce the contract.

Here, the collector may be a third-party beneficiary of the broker-man contract since the broker will sell the man's rare coin to the collector. However, the collector was only an incidental beneficiary since the broker-man contract does not show an intent to directly benefit her (Choice D). As a result, the broker will likely win since the collector has no right to sue for breach of the broker-man contract.

(Choice A) The man likely sustained damages on February 1 since he would have made a $2,000 profit on his contract with the broker - ie, the contract price ($10,000) minus the market price ($8,000). Although the collector likely has not sustained damages, she can sue under her contract with the broker if she sustains damages in the future - eg, buys an equivalent coin for more than her $12,000 contract price.

(Choice C) A party assigns his/her rights under a contract when he/she manifests a present intent to immediately transfer those rights. Here, the man did not assign his right to damages because he merely suggested that the collector sue the broker.

Educational objective: An intended beneficiary receives a direct benefit from a contract because the contracting parties so intended. An incidental beneficiary receives some indirect benefit from the contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them. And only an intended (not incidental) beneficiary has a right to enforce the contract.

选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 62%（正确选项），C选项 2%，D选项 26%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

第三方受益人


(即从合同中受益的非合同方)
类型定义执行权
意定受益人从合同中获得直接利益，因为合同双方有意使其受益。例如，A承诺为B粉刷房屋，B则承诺向C支付500美元有
附带受益人从合同中获得间接利益，即使合同没有意图使其受益。例如，A承诺为B购买一辆由C制造的汽车无
第三方受益人是指从合同中获得某些好处或利益的非合同方。第三方受益人有两种类型：
  • 意定受益人 - 从合同中获得直接利益，因为合同双方有意如此，因此有权执行该合同
  • 附带受益人 - 从合同中获得某些间接利益，即使没有合同意图使其受益，因此无权执行该合同。

在本案中，收藏家可能是经纪人与该男子之间合同的第三方受益人，因为经纪人要将该男子的稀有硬币出售给收藏家。然而，收藏家仅为一名附带受益人，因为经纪人与该男子之间的合同并未显示出直接使她受益的意图（选项D）。因此，经纪人可能会胜诉，因为收藏家无权就违反经纪人与该男子之间合同的行为提起诉讼。

（选项A） 该男子可能在2月1日遭受了损失，因为他本可以从与经纪人的合同中获利2,000美元——即合同价格（10,000美元）减去市场价格（8,000美元）。虽然收藏家可能没有遭受损失，但如果她未来遭受损失——例如，以高于其12,000美元合同价的价格购买了同等硬币——她可以根据她与经纪人的合同提起诉讼。

（选项C） 当一方当事人表示出立即转让其合同权利的当前意图时，即构成了权利转让。在本案中，该男子并没有转让其损害赔偿请求权，因为他仅仅是建议收藏家起诉经纪人。

教学目标：意定受益人从合同中获得直接利益，因为合同双方有意如此。附带受益人从合同中获得某些间接利益，即使没有合同意图使其受益。并且，只有意定受益人（而非附带受益人）有权执行合同。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).


  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 315 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (no right to enforce for incidental beneficiaries).

MBE 合同法解析

Third-Party Beneficiaries (第三方受益人)
⚖️ 核心考点：谁有权起诉？

本题考察的是非合同当事人（Nonparty）是否有权执行合同。这取决于该第三方是意定受益人还是附带受益人。

类型 (Type) 定义 (Definition) 起诉权 (Right to Sue)
意定受益人
(Intended Beneficiary)		 合同双方有意图通过合同直接使该第三方受益（如偿还债务或赠与）。 ✅ 有权
附带受益人
(Incidental Beneficiary)		 虽然能从合同履行中获益，但合同双方无意图直接使其受益。 ❌ 无权
🔍 案情逻辑分析

收藏家（Collector）起诉的是经纪人与男子之间的合同（Broker-Man Contract）。我们需要分析该合同的性质：

  • 经纪人目的： 低买高卖赚取差价（以$10k买入，以$12k卖给收藏家）。
  • 男子目的： 仅仅是出售硬币换取现金。
  • 收藏家地位： 在签订该合同时，男子甚至不知道收藏家的存在。经纪人只是为了履行自己的另一份合同而寻找货源。

结论： 收藏家只是该合同的附带受益人 (Incidental Beneficiary)。虽然如果合同履行，她能拿到硬币，但经纪人和男子签订合同并非为了“赠与”她利益或“偿还”她的债务，仅仅是商业周转。

💡 选项深度解析
选项 B (正确答案)

经纪人胜诉，因为收藏家仅仅是附带受益人。

这是对法律规则的直接应用。作为附带受益人，收藏家没有法律地位（Standing）去执行经纪人与男子之间的合同。因此，无论经纪人是否违约，收藏家都不能基于该合同起诉。

选项 D (错误)

错误原因： 选项错误地将收藏家归类为“意定受益人”。

要成为意定受益人，合同双方必须表现出使第三方受益的意图（Intent to benefit）。本案中，经纪人只是为了自己的商业利益（履行下游合同避免违约并获利），并非为了直接利好收藏家。

选项 C (错误)

错误原因： 关于权利转让（Assignment）。

男子说“你应该起诉经纪人”仅仅是一个建议或授权，并非法律上的权利转让 (Assignment)。有效的转让需要转让人表现出立即转移权利的当前意图（Present intent to transfer rights immediately）。

选项 A (错误)

错误原因： 事实认定错误。

该选项声称“无人遭受损害”是错误的。在2月1日违约时，市场价跌至$8,000，而合同价是$10,000，男子实际上遭受了$2,000的利润损失（Loss of bargain）。虽然市场后来恢复了，但违约损害赔偿通常在违约发生时确定。不过，收藏家败诉的根本原因还是在于她没有起诉权。

🎓 MBE 提分技巧：

在判断 Third-Party Beneficiary 问题时，寻找以下两个信号：
  1. Donee Beneficiary (受赠受益人)： 合同目的是为了给第三方一份礼物。
  2. Creditor Beneficiary (债权受益人)： 合同目的是为了偿还第三方已有的债务。
如果既不是送礼，也不是还债，仅仅是商业链条的下游（如本题中的转售对象），通常都是附带受益人 (Incidental Beneficiary)，无权起诉。

儿子和女儿在一月、二月和三月支付了约定的款项。然而，到了四月，儿子拒绝支付任何款项，并通知他的姐妹和母亲他将不再支付。

在4月30日之后，母亲对儿子提起的要求支付500美元的诉讼会成功吗？

A. No, because a parent cannot sue her child for breach of a promise for support.
不会，因为父母不能因其子女违反抚养承诺而起诉他们。

B. No, because the son and daughter intended their payments to their mother to be gifts.
不会，因为儿子和女儿意图将他们给母亲的付款作为赠与。

C. Yes, because by making his first three payments, the son confirmed his intent to contract.
会，因为通过支付前三笔款项，儿子确认了他的缔约意图。

D. Yes, because the mother is an intended beneficiary of a contract between the son and daughter.
会，因为母亲是儿子和女儿之间合同的意定受益人。

Third-party beneficiaries


TypeDefinitionRight to enforce
IntendedReceive direct benefit from contract because contracting parties intended to benefit them Eg, A promises to paint B's house if B promises to pay $500 to CYes
IncidentalReceive indirect benefit from contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them Eg, A promises to buy B a car manufactured by CNo
A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some benefit from that contract. The third party can enforce the contract if he/she is an intended beneficiary - ie, one whom the contracting parties intended to benefit directly.

Here, the son and daughter entered into the contract to give the mother $500 each month. Although the mother was not a party to that contract, the son and the daughter intended to confer a gift upon the mother - $500 monthly from each child. Therefore, the mother was an intended beneficiary of the contract and will succeed in an enforcement action against the son (Choice B).

(Choice A) There is no rule that a parent cannot sue a child for breach of a promise for support, but such a promise may be unenforceable for another reason - eg, if the promise lacks consideration. Here, however, the son and daughter's exchanged promises were supported by consideration.

(Choice C) The son confirmed his intent to contract when he agreed with the daughter that each would give the mother $500 monthly. Therefore, the first three payments are irrelevant to the son's intent to contract.

Educational objective: A person who is not a party to a contract may still enforce that contract if he/she is an intended beneficiary - ie, a third party whom the contracting parties intended to benefit directly.

第三方受益人


类型定义执行权
意定的从合同中获得直接利益，因为缔约方意图使他们受益。例如，A承诺为B粉刷房屋，如果B承诺向C支付500美元。有
附带的从合同中获得间接利益，即使没有使他们受益的合同意图。例如，A承诺为B购买一辆由C制造的汽车。没有
第三方受益人是指并非合同当事方，但从该合同中获得某种利益的人。如果第三方是意定受益人——即缔约方意图直接使其受益的人，则该第三方可以执行合同。

在本案中，儿子和女儿签订了每月各自给予母亲500美元的合同。虽然母亲不是该合同的当事方，但儿子和女儿意图向母亲赠与——每个孩子每月500美元。因此，母亲是该合同的意定受益人，她对儿子提起的强制执行诉讼将会成功（选项D）。

（选项A）没有规则规定父母不能因子女违反抚养承诺而起诉他们，但这样的承诺可能因其他原因而无法执行——例如，如果承诺缺乏对价。然而，在本案中，儿子和女儿交换的承诺是有对价支持的。

（选项C）当儿子与女儿同意每月各自给予母亲500美元时，他就已经确认了他的缔约意图。因此，前三次的支付与儿子的缔约意图无关。

教学目标：一个非合同当事方的人，如果其为意定受益人——即缔约方意图直接使其受益的第三方，仍然可以执行该合同。

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Third-Party Beneficiaries
核心考点：第三方受益人 Third-Party Beneficiary (TPB)

在合同法中，如果合同双方（Promisor & Promisee）在订立合同时，意图将合同利益直接赋予第三方，该第三方即为意定受益人 (Intended Beneficiary)，有权起诉强制执行合同。

✅ 正确答案解析 (Choice D)
为什么选 D？

本题的关键在于识别母亲在儿子和女儿的合同中扮演的角色。

  • 合同的形成 (Formation)： 儿子和女儿签署了书面协议，相互承诺每月支付500美元。这种相互承诺 (Mutual Promises) 构成了有效的对价 (Consideration)。
  • 意图 (Intent)： 双方订立合同的明确目的是为了让母亲有钱雇佣同伴。
  • 受益人身份： 母亲虽然不是合同的签字方，但她是合同利益的直接接收者。在法律上，她被称为受赠受益人 (Donee Beneficiary)（意定受益人的一种）。

根据 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302，意定受益人有权直接起诉承诺人（儿子）违约。

🚫 陷阱选项排除
选项 B 的陷阱：赠与 (Gift) vs. 合同

错误原因： 很多考生看到“Gift”就认为没有法律约束力。虽然儿子给母亲钱的行为本质上是赠与，但他与女儿之间的协议是合同。儿子对女儿承诺给母亲钱，女儿也对儿子承诺给母亲钱，这种“为了第三人利益的合同”是完全有效的。

选项 A 的陷阱：家庭豁免

错误原因： 法律中并没有“父母不能起诉子女违约”的通用规则。只要满足合同要素（要约、承诺、对价），家庭成员间的合同同样具有法律效力。

选项 C 的陷阱：部分履行

错误原因： 儿子在前三个月付款确实表明了意图，但合同的约束力来自于签署协议的那一刻，而不是来自于后续的付款行为。即使他一次都没付，母亲依然可以基于书面协议起诉。

🎓 MBE 备考锦囊

在处理涉及三方关系的合同题时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 识别三方： 两个订立合同的人（Promisor/Promisee）和一个受益的人（Third Party）。
  2. 判断意图： 订立合同的人是否意图 (Intend) 让第三方直接受益？
    • 如果是 ➡ Intended Beneficiary (有执行权)
    • 如果只是巧合受益 ➡ Incidental Beneficiary (无执行权)
  3. 检查权利归属 (Vesting)： 虽然本题未深入考察，但通常当受益人知晓并同意、起诉或基于合同发生信赖 (Reliance) 时，权利即确立，合同方不可随意撤销。
Key Takeaway: Intended beneficiaries can enforce contracts made for their benefit.

questions.question:
A flour manufacturer contracted to deliver to a baker her flour requirements for a one-year period. Before delivery of the first scheduled installment, the flour manufacturer sold its business and assigned all of its sale contracts to a reputable and longtime flour wholesaler. The flour manufacturer informed the baker of this transaction.
When the flour wholesaler tendered the first installment to the baker in compliance with the manufacturer-baker contract, the baker refused to accept the goods.
Which of the following arguments, if any, legally support(s) the baker's rejection of the goods?

Contract provisions prohibiting assignments/delegations


Type of provisionExplicit prohibitionsAssignment of rightsDelegation of duties
NoneN/AAllowedAllowed
SpecificAssignment of rights & delegation of dutiesBarredBarred
SpecificAssignment of rights onlyBarredAllowed
SpecificDelegation of duties onlyAllowedBarred
GeneralAssignment of "the contract"AllowedBarred
Unless stated otherwise, bilateral contracts for the sale of goods can be assigned in their entirety, and this will be construed as an assignment of rights and a delegation of duties to a nonparty (ie, delegatee). Such assignments are generally valid, even for an executory requirements contract - ie, an uncompleted contract for the sale of as many goods as the buyer needs during a specified period (Choice B). The delegatee's acceptance of the assignment constitutes a promise to perform the duties, and the promisee must accept that performance.

Here, the flour manufacturer assigned the baker's requirements contract to the flour wholesaler (delegatee), and the baker refused to accept the wholesaler's first installment of flour. However, this general language of "assignment" operates as a transfer of rights and a delegation of duties. The wholesaler's acceptance of that assignment is a promise to perform - ie, to sell the baker as much flour as she needs for one year (Choices A & C). Therefore, no argument legally supports the baker's rejection of the goods.

Educational objective: The assignment of an entire contract is construed as an assignment of rights and a delegation of duties to a nonparty (ie, delegatee). The delegatee's acceptance of the assignment constitutes a promise to perform the delegator's duties, and the promisee must accept that performance.

除非另有规定，否则货物销售的双务合同可以被整体转让，这将被解释为向非合同方（即受托人）的权利转让和义务委托。此类转让通常是有效的，即使是对于待履行的需求合同——即在一个特定时期内，根据买方需要销售尽可能多货物的未完成合同（选项B）。受托人对转让的接受构成一项履行义务的承诺，并且受诺人必须接受该履行。

在本案中，面粉制造商将与面包师签订的需求合同转让给了面粉批发商（受托人），而面包师拒绝接受批发商交付的第一批面粉。然而，“转让”这一概括性措辞的效力同时及于权利的转让和义务的委托。批发商对该转让的接受即是一项履行的承诺——即在一年内向面包师出售其所需的全部面粉（选项A和C）。因此，没有任何论点在法律上支持面包师拒绝接受货物。

教学要点：整个合同的转让被解释为向非合同方（即受托人）的权利转让和义务委托。受托人对转让的接受构成了履行转让人义务的承诺，并且受诺人必须接受该履行。

MBE 考题解析

Contracts: Assignment & Delegation
✅ 正确答案：D 没有任何法律论点支持面包师拒绝接受货物。

本题考察的是《统一商法典》（UCC）下关于合同转让与委托（Assignment and Delegation）的核心规则。

⚖️ 核心法律依据 (UCC § 2-210)

由于本案涉及面粉（货物）买卖，因此适用 UCC (Uniform Commercial Code)。

UCC 规定，除非合同另有约定，当事人使用“转让合同”（Assign the contract）或“转让所有合同”这类概括性语言时，法律将其解释为：

  1. 权利的转让 (Assignment of Rights)：即收款或收货的权利转给第三方。
  2. 义务的委托 (Delegation of Duties)：即履行合同义务的责任转给第三方。

受托人（Delegatee，本案中的批发商）接受转让，即构成其对履行义务的承诺 (Promise to perform)。因此，受托人有义务交付，买方（面包师）也有义务接受。

🔍 深度解析：为何面包师必须接受？

面包师拒绝接受货物通常需要证明“义务不可委托” (Non-delegable duties)。但在本案中，义务是可以委托的：

  • 非个人服务合同： 面粉是标准化的商品 (Standardized commodity)。面包师关心的是面粉的质量和数量，而不是必须由特定的制造商亲自研磨。这与“画肖像画”或“做手术”等高度依赖个人技能的合同不同。
  • 需求合同的可转让性： 尽管旧的普通法认为需求合同 (Requirements Contracts) 包含个人信赖因素不可转让，但 UCC 明确允许需求合同的转让，只要受让人是善意的，且需求量没有发生其无法预见的重大变化。
  • 受托人资质： 题目特别提到批发商是“声誉良好且长期经营的” (Reputable and longtime)，这意味着面包师获得履行的安全性没有受到实质性损害。
❌ 为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A & C 错误：
它们声称“转让”一词仅转移权利而不转移义务。这是错误的。根据 UCC § 2-210(4)，概括性的“转让”语言自动包含义务的委托。
选项 B & C 错误：
它们声称“待履行的需求合同不可转让”。这是旧法的观点。在现代商业法（UCC）下，需求合同是可以转让的，除非转让会实质性地改变义务人的负担。
💡 MBE 考试通关技巧

1. 区分 UCC 与 Common Law： 看到货物（Goods）买卖，优先适用 UCC。UCC 倾向于促进商业交易的自由流转。

2. 默认规则： 在没有禁止转让条款的情况下，合同通常是可转让的（Assignable）和可委托的（Delegable）。

3. 例外情况： 只有当履行涉及独特的个人技能（Personal skill/judgment）或转让会实质性改变风险时，才禁止委托。

Five years after the debt had been discharged in bankruptcy, the seller contracted to sell certain goods to a buyer for $5,000. The contract provided that the buyer would pay the $5,000 to the bank. The only debt that the seller ever owed the bank is the $5,000 debt that was discharged in bankruptcy. The seller delivered the goods to the buyer, who accepted them.
If the bank becomes aware of the contract between the seller and the buyer, and the buyer refuses to pay anything to the bank, is the bank likely to succeed in an action against the buyer for $5,000?

choices.a: No, because the buyer's promise to pay the bank was not supported by consideration.
choices.b: No, because the seller's debt was discharged in bankruptcy.
choices.c: Yes, because no consideration is required to support a promise to pay a debt that has been discharged in bankruptcy.
choices.d: Yes, because the bank was an intended beneficiary of the contract between the buyer and the seller.

在债务通过破产程序被免除五年后，卖方与一名买方签订合同，以5,000美元的价格向其出售特定货物。合同规定，买方将向银行支付这5,000美元。卖方曾欠银行的唯一债务，就是那笔已在破产中被免除的5,000美元债务。卖方将货物交付给买方，买方也接受了货物。

如果银行知晓了卖方与买方之间的合同，而买方拒绝向银行支付任何款项，那么银行对买方提起诉讼，要求其支付5,000美元，是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the buyer's promise to pay the bank was not supported by consideration.
不会，因为买方向银行付款的承诺没有对价支持。

B. No, because the seller's debt was discharged in bankruptcy.
不会，因为卖方的债务已在破产中被免除。

C. Yes, because no consideration is required to support a promise to pay a debt that has been discharged in bankruptcy.
会，因为支付已在破产中被免除的债务的承诺，无需对价支持。

D. Yes, because the bank was an intended beneficiary of the contract between the buyer and the seller.
会，因为银行是买卖双方合同的意定受益人。
data.explanation:
A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. If the contracting parties intended for the contract to benefit the third party, the third party is an intended beneficiary with enforceable rights under the contract. That right vests when the beneficiary:
  • detrimentally relies on the rights created
  • manifests assent to the contract at one party's request or
  • files a lawsuit to enforce the contract.
Once this occurs, the original contracting parties are bound to perform the contract.

Here, the bank was an intended third-party beneficiary of the buyer-seller contract because the seller agreed to sell the buyer goods in exchange for the buyer paying the bank $5,000. The bank's right to enforce the buyer-seller contract will vest once the bank files a lawsuit to enforce it. Therefore, the bank will likely succeed in an action against the buyer for $5,000.

(Choice A) The buyer's promise to pay the bank was supported by consideration since the buyer agreed to pay the bank $5,000 in exchange for the seller's goods.

(Choice B) The fact that the seller's debt to the bank was discharged in bankruptcy is irrelevant because an intended beneficiary can be a creditor or a donee beneficiary. A creditor beneficiary can recover to satisfy a debt. A donee beneficiary can recover to receive a gift. Therefore, the bank is likely an intended donee beneficiary.

(Choice C) Although no consideration is required to support a promise to pay a debt discharged in bankruptcy, this is not a reason for the bank to succeed. Instead, the bank will succeed because it is an intended beneficiary.

Educational objective: Intended third-party beneficiaries receive a direct benefit from a contract because the contracting parties intended to benefit them. They have the right to file a lawsuit to enforce the contract.

第三方受益人是指从合同中获得某种优势或利益的合同非当事方。如果合同当事方意图使第三方从合同中受益，则该第三方是意定受益人，享有合同项下可强制执行的权利。当受益人出现以下情况时，其权利即归属（vests）：
  • 对所创设的权利产生了不利信赖（detrimentally relies）
  • 应一方当事人的要求表示同意（manifests assent）该合同或
  • 提起诉讼（files a lawsuit）以执行合同。
一旦发生上述情况，原合同当事方即有义务履行合同。

在本案中，银行是买卖合同的意定第三方受益人，因为卖方同意向买方出售货物，以换取买方向银行支付5,000美元。一旦银行提起诉讼强制执行该合同，其强制执行买卖合同的权利即归属。因此，银行对买方提起诉讼，要求其支付5,000美元，很可能会胜诉。

（选项A）买方向银行付款的承诺有对价支持，因为买方同意向银行支付5,000美元以换取卖方的货物。

（选项B）卖方对银行的债务已在破产中被免除这一事实无关紧要，因为意定受益人可以是债权人受益人或受赠受益人。债权人受益人可以通过受偿来清偿债务。受赠受益人可以通过受偿来接受赠与。因此，银行很可能是一个意定的受赠受益人。

（选项C）尽管支付已在破产中被免除的债务的承诺无需对价支持，但这并非银行胜诉的理由。银行之所以胜诉，是因为它是意定受益人。

教学目的：意定第三方受益人从合同中直接获益，因为合同当事方意图使他们受益。他们有权提起诉讼来强制执行合同。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 304 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (duties owed to intended beneficiaries).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Third-Party Rights
📚 核心考点：意定第三方受益人 (Intended Third-Party Beneficiary)

当合同双方（Promisor 和 Promisee）在订立合同时，明确意图将合同利益赋予第三方时，该第三方即为意定受益人。意定受益人有权直接起诉强制执行合同。

卖方 (Promisee) 📦 交付货物 → 买方 (Promisor)
⬇️ 卖方指定付款给银行 ⬇️
买方 (Promisor) 💰 承诺支付 $5,000 → 银行 (Beneficiary)
1. 为什么选 D？(正确答案解析)

本题的关键在于识别银行的身份。虽然卖方对银行的原始债务已在破产中免除 (Discharged in Bankruptcy)，但这不影响卖方与买方订立新合同的权利。

在卖方与买方的新合同中：

  • 卖方意图：让买方直接向银行付款。
  • 买方承诺：同意向银行支付 $5,000 以换取货物。

因此，银行是意定受益人 (Intended Beneficiary)。根据《合同法重述（第二次）》(Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302)，意定受益人有权强制执行合同。当银行提起诉讼时，其权利已经归属 (Vested)，故银行会胜诉。

2. 破产免责是“红鲱鱼” (Red Herring)

题目中提到卖方的债务已在5年前被免除，这是一个典型的干扰项。许多考生会纠结于“债务已不存在”。

法律逻辑：意定受益人分为两类：

  • 债权人受益人 (Creditor Beneficiary)：用于清偿现有债务。
  • 受赠受益人 (Donee Beneficiary)：用于赠与。

即使旧债务已免除（法律上不再欠款），卖方仍有权指示买方将钱给银行（作为一种“赠与”或履行道德义务）。无论银行被归类为哪种受益人，只要是意定 (Intended) 的，就有执行权。

3. 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A 错误

关于对价 (Consideration)： 买方的承诺是有对价支持的——即卖方交付的货物。对价不需要由受益人（银行）提供，只要合同当事方之间存在交换即可。

选项 B 错误

关于债务免除： 破产免除的是卖方对银行的旧债务。它并不禁止买方在新合同中承担向银行付款的新义务。

选项 C 错误

逻辑偏差： 虽然承诺偿还已免除的债务通常不需要新对价（属于例外情况），但这通常指原债务人的承诺。本案是第三方（买方）的承诺，且买方的承诺本身就有货物作为对价。因此，银行胜诉的根本原因它是受益人，而不是因为“无需对价”。

💡 考试技巧： 在 MBE 合同法题目中，看到合同规定向第三方付款时，首先判断该第三方是否为“意定受益人”。如果是，通常该第三方拥有执行权，除非合同已被双方在权利归属(Vest)前合法修改或撤销。

面包店并未明确同意接受该糖业零售商作为其糖业供应商，并且即使糖业经销商已将合同转让给糖业零售商，其对面包店仍负有义务。

C. The bakery's payment of the contractual installment to the sugar distributor discharged its obligation.
面包店向糖业经销商支付该批合同款项的行为，解除了其付款义务。

Contract provisions prohibiting assignments/delegations


Type of provisionExplicit prohibitionsAssignment of rightsDelegation of duties
NoneN/AAllowedAllowed
SpecificAssignment of rights & delegation of dutiesBarredBarred
SpecificAssignment of rights onlyBarredAllowed
SpecificDelegation of duties onlyAllowedBarred
GeneralAssignment of "the contract"BarredBarred
Either party to a contract can assign its rights or delegate its duties to a nonparty (ie, delegatee). A general assignment of the entire contract will be construed as both an assignment of rights AND a delegation of duties. For example, a seller's general assignment of an entire contract gives the delegatee the right to receive payment directly from the buyer provided that the delegatee delivers the goods.

Here, the sugar distributor assigned the bakery's requirements contract to the sugar retailer, which operated as an assignment of rights and a delegation of duties. The retailer then had a right to receive payment directly from the bakery since the retailer delivered the first installment of sugar to it. Therefore, the bakery's payment to the distributor did not discharge its obligation to pay the retailer (Choice C).

(Choices A & B) Unless the contract states otherwise, contractual duties can be delegated without the promisee's express consent. Therefore, the bakery must accept the sugar retailer as its sugar supplier even though she did not expressly agree to do so. And though the sugar distributor remains liable to the bakery if the retailer fails to perform, the retailer did perform by delivering the first installment.

Educational objective: A general assignment of an entire contract will be construed as both an assignment of rights and a delegation of duties to a nonparty (ie, delegatee). For example, a seller's assignment of an entire contract gives the delegatee the duty to deliver the goods and the right to receive payment directly from the buyer.

在本案中，糖业经销商将与面包店的需求合同转让给了糖业零售商，此行为构成权利的转让和义务的委托。因此，零售商有权直接从面包店收取款项，因为零售商已向其交付了首批糖。因此，面包店向经销商付款的行为并未解除其向零售商付款的义务（选项C）。

（选项A和B）除非合同另有规定，否则合同义务可以在未经受诺人明确同意的情况下被委托。因此，即使面包店没有明确同意，它也必须接受糖业零售商作为其糖业供应商。而且，尽管如果零售商未能履行义务，糖业经销商仍需对面包店负责，但零售商确实通过交付首批货物履行了义务。

教学目的：对整个合同的概括转让将被解释为既是向非合同方（即受托人）的权利转让，也是义务委托。例如，卖方对整个合同的转让，赋予了受托人交付货物的义务和直接从买方处收取款项的权利。

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Third-Party Rights
核心考点：转让与通知

本题考察的是合同权利转让后，债务人（Obligor）向谁付款的问题。关键规则是：一旦债务人收到转让通知，其必须向受让人（Assignee）付款。

经销商
(Assignor)
零售商
(Assignee)
权利转让 & 义务委托
⬇️
面包店
(Obligor)
❌ 错误付款给经销商
✅ 应付款给零售商
为什么选 D (No defense)？

1. 概括转让 (General Assignment)：
根据 UCC § 2-210，当一方转让“合同”或“所有合同”时，这通常被解释为：

  • 权利转让 (Assignment of Rights)： 收款权的转移。
  • 义务委托 (Delegation of Duties)： 供货义务的转移。

2. 通知的效力 (Effect of Notice)：
题目明确指出经销商已将交易通知 (Informed) 了面包店。

关键规则： 一旦债务人（面包店）收到转让通知，其付款义务就锁定在受让人（零售商）身上。如果债务人在收到通知后仍向原债权人（经销商）付款，该付款不能解除其对受让人的债务。

因此，面包店向经销商付款是“付错了人”，它仍然欠零售商第一批货的款项。面包店没有任何有效的抗辩理由。

为什么其他选项无效？
选项 A & B (关于同意 Consent)：
错误。在货物买卖合同中，除非合同有明确的“禁止转让/委托条款”或涉及特殊的个人技能（如著名画家的画作），否则不需要获得非转让方（面包店）的明确同意。糖是标准商品，零售商也是声誉良好的商家，因此无需面包店同意。
选项 C (关于付款解除 Discharge)：
错误。如果面包店在收到通知前付款给经销商，那么债务确实解除了。但本题中，面包店是在知情后仍付给旧债主，这种付款不具有解除债务的效力。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 遇到“Assignment”（转让）题目时，请按以下步骤检查：
  1. 看通知： 债务人是否收到了通知？(Notice is King)
  2. 看时间： 付款是在通知之前还是之后？
    • 通知前付给旧人 = ✅ 有效抗辩
    • 通知后付给旧人 = ❌ 无效抗辩（需双重付款）
  3. 看性质： 是否涉及个人独特技能？(Personal Service vs. Standard Goods)

一位土地所有者为其一块精选的2000英亩土地上的成材林木发布了拟议出售的广告。

一家建筑企业为该林木权提出了一个公道的价格。土地所有者接受了该要约，双方签订了书面合同。

后来，在没有法律正当理由且不顾土地所有者强烈反对的情况下，该建筑企业在开始履行合同前毁约。该土地所有者无力聘请律师提起法律诉讼，也未曾尝试将其可能拥有的针对该建筑企业的任何诉讼因由进行转让。

如果土地所有者的隔壁邻居——其眺望附近湖泊的视野被这片成材林木所遮挡——就该建筑企业违约提起诉讼，那么该邻居会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the neighbor is a maintainer of nuisance litigation.
不会，因为该邻居是恶意诉讼的提起人。

B. No, because the neighbor is only an incidental beneficiary, if any, of the contract.
不会，因为该邻居（即便算是）也仅仅是合同的附带受益人。

C. Yes, because the neighbor is a surrogate for the landowner in view of his inability to enforce the contract.
会，因为鉴于土地所有者无力执行合同，该邻居是土地所有者的代理人。

D. Yes, because the neighbor is a third-party intended beneficiary of the contract.
会，因为该邻居是合同的第三方意定受益人。
data.explanation:
A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract. Unlike intended beneficiaries, incidental beneficiaries - ie, those whom the contracting parties did not intend to benefit directly - have no right to sue under the contract.

Here, the neighbor is at most an incidental beneficiary of the contract between the landowner and the construction enterprise since there was no contractual intent to benefit the neighbor (eg, improve the neighbor's view of the lake). As an incidental beneficiary, the neighbor has no right to sue under the contract. Therefore, the neighbor will not prevail in a breach-of-contract suit against the construction enterprise (Choice D).

(Choice A) The neighbor would not be accused of maintaining nuisance litigation (ie, bringing a bad-faith claim to harass someone) since the neighbor presumably believed (incorrectly) that he/she had the right to enforce the contract.

(Choice C) A surrogate is one who acts on behalf of another party. But here, the neighbor has no right under the contract or otherwise to enforce the contract on the landowner's behalf.

Educational objective: An incidental beneficiary - ie, a nonparty to a contract who receives some advantage or benefit from that contract even though the contracting parties did not intend to benefit him/her - has no right to sue under the contract.

第三方受益人是指并非合同当事方，但从该合同中获得某些优势或利益的人。与意定受益人不同，附带受益人——即合同双方无意直接使其受益的人——无权根据合同提起诉讼。

在本案中，该邻居最多只是土地所有者与建筑企业之间合同的一名附带受益人，因为合同中没有使邻居受益的意图（例如，改善邻居眺望湖泊的视野）。作为附带受益人，该邻居无权根据合同提起诉讼。因此，在该邻居对建筑企业提起的违约诉讼中，邻居不会胜诉（选项D错误）。

（选项A）该邻居不会被指控为进行恶意诉讼（即，为了骚扰他人而恶意提起诉讼），因为可以推定该邻居（错误地）相信自己有权执行该合同。

（选项C）代理人是代表另一方行事的人。但在本案中，该邻居没有合同上或其他方面的权利来代表土地所有者执行合同。

教学目的：附带受益人——即并非合同当事方，但尽管合同双方无意使其受益，却从该合同中获得某些优势或利益的人——无权根据合同提起诉讼。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended & incidental beneficiaries).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Third-Party Rights

✅ 正确答案：B 邻居无法胜诉，因为他只是该合同的附带受益人 (Incidental Beneficiary)。
⚖️ 核心考点：第三方受益人

在合同法中，判断第三方是否有权起诉违约方，关键在于区分两种受益人：

1. 意定受益人 (Intended Beneficiary)

合同双方在订立合同时，明确意图使该第三方受益。此类受益人有权起诉 (Standing to sue)。

例如：A付钱给B，让B给C修房子。C是意定受益人。

2. 附带受益人 (Incidental Beneficiary)

虽然从合同履行中获益，但合同双方并无意图专门使其受益。此类受益人无权起诉。

例如：A雇B修路，路修好后C的房价涨了。C只是附带受益人。

🔍 案情分析逻辑
1
合同目的：土地所有者 (Landowner) 与建筑企业 (Construction Enterprise) 签订合同是为了买卖木材 (Sale of timber)。
2
双方意图：没有任何证据表明土地所有者卖树是为了改善邻居的视野。邻居视野变好只是砍树这一商业行为的副作用 (Byproduct)。
3
结论：邻居属于典型的附带受益人。根据《合同法重述（第二次）》§ 302，他没有权利强制执行该合同。
❌ 干扰项排除
选项 A (Nuisance Litigation): 错误。这是侵权法概念。邻居起诉是因为误解了自己的合同权利，并非恶意的骚扰诉讼。
选项 C (Surrogate): 错误。虽然土地所有者没钱打官司，但这并不自动将诉权转移 (Assign) 给邻居。邻居不是土地所有者的法定代理人。
选项 D (Intended Beneficiary): 错误。这是本题最大的陷阱。仅仅因为邻居会受益，并不等于他是“意定”受益人。必须看合同双方的意图 (Intent)。
💡 MBE 备考技巧

在做此类题目时，请寻找“意图 (Intent)”的证据：

  • 合同里是否提到了该第三方？
  • 履行行为是否直接交付给该第三方？

如果没有明确的意图证据，第三方通常默认为附带受益人，无权起诉。

A manufacturer of poultry-feed supplements contracted to purchase methylmercaptopropanol (MMP), a key component of its top-selling supplement, from a chemical company. The chemical company agreed to manufacture the MMP and ship it by rail to the manufacturer. The chemical company subsequently contracted with a rail carrier to ship hundreds of products to and from the chemical company's manufacturing facilities. Among the products to be shipped was the MMP. The rail contract required the rail carrier to "ensure quality service to [the chemical company]" by being "responsive to the special needs of [the chemical company] whenever possible."
The rail carrier inexcusably failed to transport sufficient amounts of MMP to the manufacturer. The reduced supply of MMP forced the manufacturer to suffer a significant reduction in the production and inventory of its top-selling supplement. The manufacturer had to transport smaller amounts of the supplement by faster and more expensive methods to satisfy customer demand.
The manufacturer sued the rail carrier to recover the increased freight costs that resulted from the carrier's breach of the rail contract.
Will the manufacturer be likely to prevail?

choices.c: Yes, because the manufacturer had a vested interest in performance of the rail contract.

一家禽饲料补充剂制造商与一家化学公司签订合同，购买甲基巯基丙醇（MMP），这是其最畅销补充剂的关键成分。该化学公司同意生产MMP并通过铁路运输给该制造商。随后，该化学公司与一家铁路承运人签订合同，负责往返运输其生产设施的数百种产品。MMP是待运输的产品之一。铁路合同要求铁路承运人“尽可能响应[化学公司]的特殊需求”，从而“确保为[化学公司]提供优质服务”。

该铁路承运人无正当理由地未能向制造商运输足够数量的MMP。MMP供应的减少迫使该制造商大幅削减其最畅销补充剂的生产和库存。为满足客户需求，该制造商不得不采用更快、更昂贵的方式运输少量补充剂。

制造商起诉铁路承运人，要求其赔偿因承运人违反铁路合同而增加的运费。

制造商很可能胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the manufacturer and the rail carrier were not in privity of contract.
不会，因为制造商与铁路承运人之间不存在合同相对性。

B. No, because the manufacturer received only an incidental benefit under the rail contract.
不会，因为制造商在铁路合同下仅获得附带利益。

C. Yes, because the manufacturer had a vested interest in performance of the rail contract.
会，因为制造商在铁路合同的履行中拥有既得利益。

D. Yes, because the parties intended for the rail contract to directly benefit the manufacturer.
会，因为双方当事人意图让铁路合同直接使制造商受益。
data.explanation:
A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives some benefit from the contract. There are two types of beneficiaries: intended and incidental. A beneficiary is intended rather than incidental, as the name suggests, if the contracting parties clearly intended for him/her to benefit from the contract. Courts glean intent from what the parties said in their contract, not what they allegedly meant. And only intended beneficiaries (not incidental ones) can sue to enforce the contract.

Here, the manufacturer benefited from the rail contract since the MMP was among the products to be shipped pursuant to that contract. However, nothing in the contract shows that the parties clearly intended to benefit the manufacturer - eg, had they included a provision that the contract was made for the manufacturer's benefit or that the manufacturer had the right to enforce it. This means that the manufacturer was, at most, an incidental beneficiary of the contract (Choice D). Therefore, it likely will not prevail in its suit against the rail carrier.

(Choice A) Traditionally, the doctrine of privity of contract prevented individuals from enforcing contracts to which they were not a party. But

this doctrine has been eroded to allow intended beneficiaries to enforce contracts made for their benefit. Therefore, had the manufacturer been an intended beneficiary of the rail contract, a lack of privity would not have defeated its claim.

(Choices C) An intended beneficiary's rights vest when the beneficiary
  • reasonably and detrimentally relies on the rights created,
  • assents to the contract at a party's request, or
  • sues to enforce the contract.
† But here, the manufacturer was an incidental beneficiary, if any, of the rail contract with no rights to vest. Therefore, neither the manufacturer's suit to enforce the contract nor its reliance on the rail company's promises is relevant.

†Once the beneficiary's rights have vested, the contracting parties are bound to perform the contract. Any efforts to terminate or modify the beneficiary's rights after vesting are void unless the beneficiary agrees.

Educational objective: A third-party beneficiary is intended (as opposed to incidental) if the contracting parties clearly intended for him/her to benefit from the contract. Only intended beneficiaries can sue to enforce the contract.

第三方受益人是指从合同中获得某种利益的合同非当事人。受益人有两种类型：意定受益人和附带受益人。顾名思义，如果合同当事人明确意图让其从合同中受益，则该受益人是意定受益人而非附带受益人。法院从当事人在合同中的表述来判断其意图，而不是他们声称的意图。并且只有意定受益人（而非附带受益人）才能起诉强制执行该合同。

在本案中，制造商从铁路合同中受益，因为MMP是根据该合同待运输的产品之一。然而，合同中没有任何内容表明当事人明确意图使制造商受益——例如，他们并未包含为制造商利益而订立合同或制造商有权执行合同的条款。这意味着制造商最多只是该合同的附带受益人(选项D)。因此，其对铁路承运人的诉讼很可能不会胜诉。

(选项A) 传统上，合同相对性原则阻止非合同当事人强制执行合同。但是

这一原则已被削弱，允许意定受益人强制执行为其利益而订立的合同。因此，如果制造商是铁路合同的意定受益人，缺乏合同相对性将不会使其诉求失败。

(选项C) 当受益人出现以下情况时，意定受益人的权利即告确定：
  • 对所创设的权利产生了合理的、不利的信赖，
  • 应一方当事人的要求同意该合同，或
  • 提起诉讼以强制执行该合同。

教学目标：如果合同当事人明确意图让第三方从合同中受益，则该第三方是意定受益人（相对于附带受益人）。只有意定受益人才能起诉强制执行该合同。

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Third-Party Rights
核心考点：意定 vs. 附带受益人

在合同法中，只有意定受益人 (Intended Beneficiary) 才有权起诉强制执行合同。而附带受益人 (Incidental Beneficiary) 仅仅是因为合同履行而“顺便”获益，没有诉权。

合同关系 (Privity)
化学公司
(Promisee)
↔
铁路承运人
(Promisor)
合同条款："服务于化学公司"
制造商 (Manufacturer)
(仅获得附带利益)
❌ 无权起诉 (No Standing)

⚖️ 法律分析

本题的关键在于判断制造商（Manufacturer）在铁路合同中的地位。

1. 判别标准 (The Test)：
要成为意定受益人，合同双方（特别是受诺人，即化学公司）必须有明确的意图 (Clear Intent) 让第三方受益。通常表现为：

  • 合同明确提及第三方；
  • 履行直接针对第三方；
  • 受诺人意图赋予第三方执行权。

2. 本案事实 (Application)：
题目中的合同语言非常关键：

  • 合同目的是运输“数百种产品”；
  • 条款要求承运人“确保为[化学公司]提供优质服务”；
  • 要求响应“[化学公司]的特殊需求”。

这些措辞表明，合同的主要目的是为了化学公司的商业利益，而不是为了下游客户（制造商）。虽然制造商确实因为运输失败受损，但它只是该合同庞大运输网络中的一个附带受益者。

✅ 正确答案：选项 B

正确 "No, because the manufacturer received only an incidental benefit..."

因为制造商只是附带受益人 (Incidental Beneficiary)，根据法律规定，附带受益人没有资格（Standing）起诉违约方。合同并非专门为其利益而设。

❌ 错误选项辨析

选项 A 关于合同相对性 (Privity)
虽然缺乏相对性是事实，但这并不是理由。如果是意定受益人，即使没有相对性也可以起诉。本题败诉的根本原因不是缺乏相对性，而是缺乏“意定受益人”的身份。

选项 C 关于既得利益 (Vested Interest)
权利确定的前提是首先拥有权利。既然制造商只是附带受益人，它从一开始就没有合同权利，因此谈不上权利是否“确定 (Vested)”。

选项 D 关于当事人意图 (Intent)
这是对事实的错误认定。合同语言明确指向服务于化学公司，而非制造商。

💡 MBE 解题技巧：
在涉及 Third-Party Beneficiary 的题目中，默认假设第三方是 Incidental (附带的)，除非你能在题干中找到明确的语言表明合同双方意图让该第三方直接受益（例如：指定向第三方付款，或合同明确说明是为了第三方的利益）。如果合同只是为了方便原合同方做生意，第三方通常无权起诉。

If the son sues the dealership for breach of contract, which of the following will the court probably decide?

A. The dealership wins, because it reasonably and prejudicially relied on its contract of mutual rescission with the widow by selling the only readily available new luxury sedan to another buyer.

Intended third-party beneficiaries' recovery for breach


Type of beneficiaryVersus party obligated topayfor benefitVersus party obligated toconferbenefit
Donee (recipient of gift)Cannot recover unless detrimental reliance satisfiedCan recover if rights vested through: detrimental reliance manifestation of assent OR lawsuit
Creditor (satisfaction of debt)Can recoverCan recover
A contract formed for the primary purpose of benefitting a third party can be modified or rescinded until the rights of the third party (ie, intended beneficiary ) have vested. Vesting occurs when the beneficiary:
  • detrimentally relies on the rights created
  • manifests assent to the contract at one party's request or
  • files a lawsuit to enforce the contract.

Vested rights cannot be modified without the beneficiary's consent, and vesting allows the beneficiary to recover for breach from the party obligated to confer the benefit.

Here, the widow contracted with the dealership to buy a luxury sedan for her son - the intended beneficiary of the contract. On May 20, the son prejudicially (ie, detrimentally) relied on this prospective gift by selling his sports car at a bargain price. The son's rights vested at that time, so the widow and the dealership could not rescind the contract on May 25 without his consent. And because the dealership sold the sedan to another buyer, the son will probably win his breach-of-contract suit.

(Choice A) It was unreasonable for the dealership to rely on its contract of mutual rescission since the son had already informed the dealership about the sale of his sports car in reliance on the prospective gift.

(Choice B) The son was a donee beneficiary because the luxury sedan was a gift. But his vested rights could not be modified without his consent, regardless of whether he was a donee or creditor beneficiary.

(Choice C) Although contract rights can be assigned (ie, transferred) for value, the son was an intended third-party beneficiary (not an assignee) since his gift was the primary purpose of the contract.

Educational objective: An intended beneficiary's contractual rights vest when the beneficiary (1) detrimentally relies on the rights created, (2) manifests assent to the contract, or (3) sues to enforce it. Once vesting occurs, the contracting parties cannot modify the beneficiary's rights without the beneficiary's consent.

受益人类型对有义务支付对价的一方对有义务授予利益的一方
受赠人 (礼物的接受者)除非满足了不利信赖的条件，否则不能获得赔偿如果权利通过以下方式归属，则可以获得赔偿：不利信赖、应一方要求作出同意的表示或提起诉讼
债权人 (债务的清偿)可以获得赔偿可以获得赔偿
为第三方利益而订立的合同，在第三方（即意图受益人）的权利归属（vested）之前，可以被修改或解除。权利归属（Vesting）发生在受益人：
  • 对所创设的权利产生了不利信赖
  • 应一方当事人的要求对合同表示同意，或
  • 提起诉讼以执行合同。

已归属的权利未经受益人同意不得修改，并且权利归属允许受益人向有义务授予利益的一方因违约获得赔偿。

在本案中，寡妇与经销商签订合同，为她的儿子购买一辆豪华轿车——儿子是该合同的意图受益人。5月20日，儿子因信赖这份预期的赠与，以甩卖价出售了自己的跑车，从而遭受了损害（即构成了不利信赖）。儿子的权利在当时即已归属，因此寡妇和经销商在5月25日未经他同意不能解除合同。并且由于经销商将轿车卖给了另一位买家，儿子很可能会赢得他的违约诉讼。

（选项 A）经销商信赖其双方合意解除合同是不合理的，因为儿子已经通知经销商，他因信赖该预期赠与而出售了自己的跑车。

（选项 B）儿子是一个受赠受益人，因为这辆豪华轿车是一份礼物。但无论他是受赠受益人还是债权受益人，他已归属的权利未经其同意均不得修改。

（选项 C）尽管合同权利可以有偿转让（即 assignment），但儿子是一个意图第三方受益人（而非受让人），因为赠与他是该合同的主要目的。

教学目的：意图受益人的合同权利在受益人（1）对所创设的权利产生不利信赖，（2）对合同表示同意，或（3）提起诉讼以执行合同时，即告归属（vest）。一旦权利归属，合同双方未经受益人同意，不得修改其权利。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 311 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (variation of a duty to a beneficiary).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Third-Party Rights
正确答案：D

儿子胜诉，因为他作为第三方意图受益人的权利，因其不利信赖（Detrimental Reliance）而已经归属（Vested）。

核心考点：第三方受益人权利的归属

在合同法中，原始合同双方通常有权修改或解除（Rescind）合同。但是，一旦第三方意图受益人（Intended Third-Party Beneficiary）的权利发生“归属”（Vesting），原始双方未经该受益人同意，不得修改或解除合同。

权利归属（Vesting）通常发生在以下三种情况之一：

  • 受益人得知合同并产生了不利信赖（Detrimental Reliance）；
  • 受益人应合同方要求对合同表示了同意（Manifests Assent）；
  • 受益人提起诉讼（Lawsuit）以执行合同。
本案案情分析

本题考察的是上述规则的具体应用：

  1. 合同性质：寡妇与经销商签订合同，目的是送给儿子礼物。儿子是典型的受赠受益人（Donee Beneficiary），属于意图受益人，有权执行合同。
  2. 关键时间点：
    • 5月20日：儿子得知合同，并基于信赖以低价卖掉了旧车（构成了实质性的地位改变/不利信赖）。他通知了寡妇和经销商。此时，儿子的权利已经归属（Vested）。
    • 5月25日：寡妇和经销商试图解除合同。
  3. 结论：由于儿子的权利在5月20日已经归属，5月25日的解除协议对儿子无效。经销商拒绝交付车辆构成违约。
干扰项解析
选项 A 错误
经销商不能主张“信赖解除协议”。因为在解除协议签署前，经销商已经被告知儿子卖掉了旧车（即已知晓受益人的权利已归属）。此时再试图解除合同属于恶意或不合理的行为，不受法律保护。
选项 B 错误
虽然儿子确实是“受赠受益人”（Donee Beneficiary），但这并不妨碍他胜诉。现代合同法（及 Restatement）规定，一旦权利归属，无论是债权受益人还是受赠受益人，其权利都受到保护，不可被随意剥夺。
选项 C 错误
这是一个术语混淆项。儿子是“受益人”（Beneficiary），而不是“受让人”（Assignee）。Assignment（转让）涉及权利的转移，而本案是合同初衷就是为了第三方利益。虽然结果相似（儿子有权起诉），但法律定性错误。
💡 MBE 备考技巧

看到涉及“第三方”（Third-Party）的合同题，按以下步骤思考：
  1. 定性：是意图受益人（Intended）还是附带受益人（Incidental）？只有前者有权起诉。
  2. 归属：权利是否已 Vest？（找三个标志：信赖、同意、起诉）。
  3. 时间线：修改/解除合同发生在 Vesting 之前还是之后？
    • 之前 ➡️ 修改有效。
    • 之后 ➡️ 修改无效（除非受益人同意）。

Third-party beneficiaries

(ie, nonparties who benefit from contract)
TypeDefinitionRight to enforce
IntendedReceive direct benefit from contract because contracting parties intended to benefit them Eg, A promises to paint B's house if B promises to pay $500 to CYes
IncidentalReceive indirect benefit from contract even though there was no contractual intent to benefit them Eg, A promises to buy B a car manufactured by CNo
A third-party beneficiary is a nonparty to a contract who receives an advantage or benefit from the contract. The third party can enforce the contract if the third party is an intended beneficiary (ie, one whom the contracting parties intended to benefit directly). Although unusual, a third party does not need to be named in the contract to be an intended beneficiary or have enforcement rights.

Here, the man promised to pay the full purchase price to "anyone" from whom the son bought a minivan within the next six months. The son bought a minivan from the dealership within that time frame, making the dealership an intended beneficiary of the contract between the man and the son. This is true even though the dealership was neither identified when the man's promise was made nor aware of the promise when the minivan was sold (Choice A). Therefore, the dealership can enforce the man's promise and recover the $8,000 purchase price.

(Choice B) Under the statute of frauds, certain contracts must be in writing. This includes suretyships - ie, contracts in which one party (surety) promises a second party (obligee) that the surety will answer for the debt of a third party (principal). Here, the father's promise was to the son - not the dealership - so the suretyship clause of the statute of frauds does not apply.

(Choice D) An intended beneficiary does not need to rely on the doctrine of promissory estoppel - which allows a party to enforce a promise on which it relied when no valid contract was formed - to enforce its rights.

Educational objective: A third party who receives some advantage or benefit from a contract can enforce the contract if the third party is an intended beneficiary - even if the third party is not specifically named in the contract.

意定受益人因合同方意图使其受益而从合同中获得直接利益。例如，A承诺为B的房屋刷漆，前提是B承诺向C支付500美元。有
附带受益人尽管没有使其受益的合同意图，但仍从合同中获得间接利益。例如，A承诺为B购买一辆由C制造的汽车。无
第三方受益人是指从合同中获得优势或利益的非合同方。如果第三方是意定受益人（即合同各方意图使其直接受益的人），则该第三方可以强制执行合同。尽管不常见，但第三方无需在合同中被指名即可成为意定受益人或拥有强制执行权。

在本案中，该男子承诺在未来六个月内向其儿子购买小型货车的“任何人”支付全额购车款。儿子在此时间范围内从该经销商处购买了一辆小型货车，这使得该经销商成为男子与儿子之间合同的意定受益人。尽管在该男子作出承诺时经销商的身份尚未确定，且在售出小型货车时经销商对此承诺并不知情，但情况依然如此（选项A）。因此，该经销商可以强制执行该男子的承诺，并获得8000美元的购车款。

（选项B）根据statute of frauds（反欺诈法），某些合同必须以书面形式订立。这包括保证合同——即一方（保证人）向另一方（债权人）承诺，保证人将为第三方（主债务人）的债务负责的合同。在本案中，父亲的承诺是向儿子作出的，而不是向经销商作出的，因此statute of frauds中的保证条款不适用。

（选项D）意定受益人无需依赖promissory estoppel（禁止反言允诺）原则来强制执行其权利，该原则允许一方在没有成立有效合同的情况下，强制执行其所信赖的承诺。

教学目标：从合同中获得某种优势或利益的第三方，如果其是意定受益人，就可以强制执行该合同——即使该第三方在合同中没有被具体指名。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 308 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (identification of beneficiaries).

MBE 考点解析：第三方受益人

本题的核心考点在于合同法中的第三方受益人权利 (Third-Party Beneficiary Rights) 以及如何区分意定受益人与附带受益人。

1. 核心法律规则

意定受益人 (Intended Beneficiary)
如果合同双方在订立合同时，意图将合同利益直接赋予第三方，该第三方即为意定受益人，拥有强制执行合同 (Right to Enforce) 的权利。

要成为意定受益人，必须满足以下条件之一（根据 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302）：

  • 履行合同义务将清偿受诺人对第三方的债务（即债权受益人 Creditor Beneficiary）；或者
  • 受诺人意图将履行的利益作为礼物赠予第三方（即受赠受益人 Donee Beneficiary）。

2. 案情分析与正确答案 (C)

在本案中，父亲（Promisor）向儿子（Promisee）承诺支付儿子购买小型货车的款项。

  • 意图明确： 父亲明确承诺向“任何人 (anyone)”支付款项。这意味着父亲的履行直接流向了卖车的人（经销商）。
  • 身份识别： 虽然在承诺时经销商尚未确定，但法律不要求受益人在合同订立时必须被具体指名或知晓该合同。只要受益人属于合同描述的特定类别 (Class of Persons) 即可。

因此，经销商一旦卖车给儿子，就成为了该类别中的一员，即意定受益人，有权直接起诉父亲要求付款。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

❌ 选项 A (关于知情权) 错误原因： 第三方受益人无需在合同订立时被指名，也无需当时就知道合同的存在。只要在试图执行权利时，其身份已确定即可。
❌ 选项 B (Statute of Frauds / 保证条款) 这是本题最大的陷阱。
Suretyship provision（保证条款）要求“为他人债务担保”的承诺必须书面化。但是，这一规则仅适用于向债权人 (Creditor) 做出的承诺。

在本案中，父亲是向债务人 (Debtor/Son) 做出的承诺。
规则： 向主债务人承诺偿还其债务，不属于反欺诈法管辖范围，口头承诺有效。
❌ 选项 D (Promissory Estoppel) 错误原因： Promissory Estoppel (禁止反言) 通常用于没有有效合同（缺乏对价）的情况。本题中明确指出有“有效且充分的对价 (valid and sufficient consideration)”，因此存在有效合同，无需退而求其次使用 Estoppel。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧
当看到“为他人支付债务”的口头承诺时：
  1. 首先判断承诺是给谁的？
    • 给债权人 → 需要书面 (Statute of Frauds)。
    • 给债务人 → 口头有效 (本题情况)。
  2. 判断第三方是否受益？
    • 如果是直接收款方 → 意定受益人，可强制执行。

A computer retail outlet contracted to service a bank's computer equipment for one year at a fixed monthly fee under a contract that was silent as to assignment or delegation by either party. Three months later, the retail outlet sold the service portion of its business to an experienced and well-financed computer service company. The only provision in the agreement between the retail outlet and the computer service company relating to the outlet's contract with the bank stated that the outlet "hereby assigns all of its computer service contracts to the computer service company."
The computer service company performed the monthly maintenance required under the service contract. Its performance was defective, however, and caused damage to the bank's operations.
Whom can the bank sue for damages arising from the computer service company's defective performance?

choices.a: Either the retail outlet or the computer service company, because since each has the right to enforce the bank's performance of its contract with the retail outlet, mutuality of remedy renders either potentially liable for the defective performance.
choices.b: Either the retail outlet or the computer service company, because the bank has not released the outlet and the bank is an intended beneficiary of the outlet's agreement with the computer service company.
choices.c: The computer service company only, because it is a qualified and a financially responsible supplier of computer services.
choices.d: The retail outlet only, because the computer service company made no promises to the bank.

Q81240

A computer retail outlet contracted to service a bank's computer equipment for one year at a fixed monthly fee under a contract that was silent as to assignment or delegation by either party. Three months later, the retail outlet sold the service portion of its business to an experienced and well- financed computer service company. The only provision in the agreement between the retail outlet and the computer service company relating to the outlet's contract with the bank stated that the outlet "hereby assigns all of its computer service contracts to the computer service company."

The computer service company performed the monthly maintenance required under the service contract. Its performance was defective, however, and caused damage to the bank's operations.

Whom can the bank sue for damages arising from the computer service company's defective performance?

一家电脑零售店与一家银行签订合同，为银行的电脑设备提供为期一年的服务，并收取固定的月费。该合同未对任何一方的转让或委托作出规定。三个月后，该零售店将其业务中的服务部分出售给了一家经验丰富、资金雄厚的电脑服务公司。零售店与电脑服务公司之间的协议中，唯一与零售店同银行的合同相关的条款规定，零售店“特此将其所有电脑服务合同转让给电脑服务公司”。

电脑服务公司履行了服务合同所要求的每月维护工作。然而，其履行存在瑕疵，给银行的运营造成了损害。

对于电脑服务公司因瑕疵履行而造成的损害，银行可以向谁起诉要求赔偿？
options:
A. Either the retail outlet or the computer service company, because since each has the right to enforce the bank's performance of its contract with the retail outlet, mutuality of remedy renders either potentially liable for the defective performance.
零售店或电脑服务公司均可，因为既然双方都有权强制银行履行其与零售店的合同，救济的相互性（mutuality of remedy）使得任何一方都可能对瑕疵履行承担责任。

B. Either the retail outlet or the computer service company, because the bank has not released the outlet and the bank is an intended beneficiary of the outlet's agreement with the computer service company.
零售店或电脑服务公司均可，因为银行并未免除零售店的责任，并且银行是零售店与电脑服务公司之间协议的意定受益人。

C. The computer service company only, because it is a qualified and a financially responsible supplier of computer services.
仅电脑服务公司，因为它是一家合格且财务状况良好的电脑服务供应商。

D. The retail outlet only, because the computer service company made no promises to the bank.
仅零售店，因为电脑服务公司没有对银行做出任何承诺。
data.explanation:
Contractual duties can be delegated by a party (ie, the promisor) to a nonparty (ie, the delegatee). An assignment of the entire contract will be construed as an assignment of rights and a delegation of duties. But even after a delegation of duties, the promisor remains liable for breach if the delegatee fails to perform - unless the promisee agrees to release the promisor from his/her duties.

Here, the computer retail outlet and the bank entered a service contract that was silent as to assignment or delegation by either party. The retail outlet assigned the entire contract (ie, rights and duties) to a computer service company, but the bank did not release the retail outlet from its duties. So even though the computer service company was qualified and financially responsible, the bank can sue the retail outlet for damages arising from the computer service company's defective performance (Choice C).

When, as here, the promisor delegates his/her duties by forming a separate contract with the delegatee, the promisee of the original contract becomes an intended beneficiary of that separate contract. This allows the promisee to sue the delegatee (in addition to the promisor) in the event of a breach. The bank, as the intended beneficiary of the agreement between the retail outlet and the computer service company, can therefore sue the computer service company for damages - even though it made no promises to the bank (Choice D).

(Choice A) Under the mutuality-of-remedy doctrine, neither party to a contract can obtain specific performance unless that remedy is available to both parties. But this doctrine is irrelevant to determining whom the bank can sue for damages.

Educational objective: A party to a contract (ie, the promisor) can delegate his/her duties to a nonparty (ie, the delegatee). But even after this occurs, the promisor remains liable for breach if the delegatee fails to perform - unless the promisee agrees to release the promisor from his/her duties.



选项正确率统计：A选项 17%，B选项 72%（正确选项），C选项 3%，D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

合同义务可由一方（即允诺人 promisor）委托给非合同方（即受托人 delegatee）。整个合同的转让将被解释为权利的转让和义务的委托。但即使在义务被委托后，如果受托人未能履行，允诺人仍需对违约负责——除非受诺人（promisee）同意免除允诺人的义务。

在本案中，电脑零售店与银行签订了一份服务合同，该合同未对任何一方的转让或委托作出规定。零售店将整个合同（即权利和义务）转让给了一家电脑服务公司，但银行并未免除零售店的义务。因此，尽管电脑服务公司是合格且有财务能力的，银行仍可以因电脑服务公司的瑕疵履行所造成的损害而起诉零售店（选项C）。

如本案中，当允诺人通过与受托人订立单独合同来委托其义务时，原合同的受诺人成为该单独合同的意定受益人。这使得受诺人在发生违约时，可以（在起诉允诺人的同时）起诉受托人。因此，银行作为零售店与电脑服务公司之间协议的意定受益人，可以就损害起诉电脑服务公司——尽管该公司未对银行作出任何承诺（选项D）。

（选项A）根据救济相互性（mutuality-of-remedy）原则，合同任何一方都不能获得特定履行（specific performance），除非该救济对双方都可用。但该原则与确定银行可以就损害赔偿起诉谁无关。

教学目标：合同一方（即允诺人 promisor）可以将其义务委托给非合同方（即受托人 delegatee）。但即使在委托发生后，如果受托人未能履行，允诺人仍需对违约负责——除非受诺人同意免除允诺人的义务。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 318 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that delegation of a contractual duty does not discharge the promisor's liability for breach).

MBE Contracts Analysis

合同的转让与委托

正确答案：B 零售店或电脑服务公司均可被起诉。因为银行未免除零售店的责任，且银行是零售店与服务公司协议的意定受益人。
核心考点 1：原债务人的责任

规则： 义务的委托（Delegation of Duties）本身并不会免除原债务人（Delegator）的责任。

除非债权人（银行）明确同意释放原债务人，即达成更替合同 (Novation)，否则原债务人（零售店）仍需对受托人的违约行为负责。

在本案中，银行并未签署任何免责声明，因此零售店仍需负责。

核心考点 2：受托人的责任

规则： 当合同被“全部转让”时，通常解释为权利的转让（Assignment of Rights）加上义务的承担（Assumption of Duties）。

当受托人（电脑服务公司）承诺承担义务时，原债权人（银行）就成为了该承诺的意定第三人受益人 (Intended Third-Party Beneficiary)。

因此，银行有权直接起诉电脑服务公司，尽管他们之间没有直接的合同签署行为。

责任流向图解

零售店 (Delegator)
⬇️ 委托义务 (Delegation)
服务公司 (Delegatee)

银行 (Bank) 可以起诉谁？
零售店 (因为未免责)
AND
服务公司 (作为受益人)
干扰项解析
  • 选项 A (Mutuality of Remedy): 错误。救济的相互性通常用于判断是否适用“特定履行”(Specific Performance)，与金钱损害赔偿的责任主体认定无关。
  • 选项 C (Only Service Co.): 错误。虽然服务公司有责任，但这不免除零售店的责任（除非有 Novation）。
  • 选项 D (Only Retail Outlet): 错误。服务公司通过接受“所有合同的转让”，法律上视为承诺履行义务，因此银行作为受益人可以直接起诉它。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧：
看到题目中出现 "assigns the contract"（转让合同）这种笼统表述时，UCC 和 Restatement 都将其解释为：
  1. 权利的转让 (Assignment of Rights)
  2. PLUS 义务的委托与承担 (Delegation & Assumption of Duties)
记住口诀：委托不免责 (Delegation does not release liability)，除非题目明确提到债权人同意释放 (Release/Novation)。

questions.question:
Under the terms of a written contract, a contractor agreed to construct a garage for a homeowner for $10,000. Nothing was stated in the parties' negotiations or in the contract about progress payments during the course of the work. After completing 25% of the garage strictly according to the homeowner's specifications, the contractor assigned his rights under the contract to a bank as security for an $8,000 loan. The bank immediately notified the homeowner of the assignment.
The contractor then, without legal excuse, abandoned the job before it was half-complete. The contractor subsequently defaulted on the loan from the bank. The contractor has no assets. It will cost the homeowner at least $8,000 to get the garage finished by another builder.
If the bank sues the homeowner for $8,000, which of the following will the court decide?

choices.a: The bank wins, because the bank as a secured creditor over the contractor is entitled to priority over the homeowner's unsecured claim against the contractor.
choices.b: The bank wins, because the contract was in existence and the contractor was not in breach when the bank gave the homeowner notice of the assignment.
choices.c: The homeowner wins, because her claim against the contractor arose prior to the contractor's default on his loan from the bank.
choices.d: The homeowner wins, because her right to recoupment on account of the contractor's breach is available against the bank as the contractor's assignee.

If the bank sues the homeowner for $8,000, which of the following will the court decide?

根据一份书面合同的条款，一名承包商同意为一名房主建造一个车库，价格为10,000美元。在双方的谈判或合同中，均未提及在工作过程中的进度款支付事宜。在严格按照房主的规格要求完成了25%的车库工程后，该承包商将其合同项下的权利转让给一家银行，作为一笔8,000美元贷款的担保。该银行立即将此项权利转让通知了房主。

随后，在没有法律正当理由的情况下，该承包商在工作完成一半之前放弃了该项目。该承包商随后拖欠了银行的贷款。该承包商没有任何资产。房主将需要花费至少8,000美元才能由另一位建筑商完成该车库的建造。

如果银行因8,000美元起诉房主，法院将作何裁决？
options:
A. The bank wins, because the bank as a secured creditor over the contractor is entitled to priority over the homeowner's unsecured claim against the contractor.
银行胜诉，因为银行作为承包商的有担保债权人，其权利优先于房主对承包商的无担保债权。

B. The bank wins, because the contract was in existence and the contractor was not in breach when the bank gave the homeowner notice of the assignment.
银行胜诉，因为在银行向房主发出权利转让通知时，合同是存在的，且承包商并未违约。

C. The homeowner wins, because her claim against the contractor arose prior to the contractor's default on his loan from the bank.
房主胜诉，因为她对承包商的索赔产生于承包商拖欠其银行贷款之前。

D. The homeowner wins, because her right to recoupment on account of the contractor's breach is available against the bank as the contractor's assignee.
房主胜诉，因为她因承包商违约而享有的抵消权可以向作为承包商受让人的银行主张。
data.explanation:
Assignment of contractual rights


Limitationsmaterially increases obligor's contractual duties or risks materially reduces obligor's chance of obtaining performance or is void (not merely prohibited) under contract provision
RequirementsPresent intent to immediately assign right Consideration generally required to make assignment irrevocable

Exceptions: promissory estoppel, delivery of document symbolizing assigned right (eg, stock certificate), delivery of written & signed assignment
Assignee'srightsAssumes all of assignor's rights as contract stands at time of assignment, subject to claims/defenses that:

accrued before obligor received notice of assignment or stem from assignor's present or future failure to perform Assignor loses rights & therefore cannot enforce contract
A party to a contract is generally free to assign (ie, transfer) its contractual rights to another. The recipient of those rights (assignee) then steps into the shoes of the assigning party (assignor) and assumes all of the assignor's contractual rights to the obligor's performance as they stand at the time of the assignment. However, those rights are subject to any claims or defenses that:
  • accrued before the obligor received notice of the assignment or
  • stem from the assignor's present or future failure to perform (Choice B).


Here, the contractor assigned his contractual rights to the bank - including the right to sue the homeowner for money owed under the contract up to the amount of the bank loan ($8,000). However, the bank's recovery is subject to the homeowner's right to recoup $8,000 for the contractor's subsequent failure to finish the garage. Since this fully offsets the bank's recovery, the court will decide for the homeowner.

(Choice A) The priority of secured and unsecured claims is relevant in bankruptcy proceedings and other situations where claims are paid in order of priority. But here, the bank's secured-creditor status over the contractor does not affect the homeowner's right to offset the bank's recovery.

(Choice C) Had the homeowner's claim been unrelated to the contractor's failure to perform, the timing of the breach and when she received notice of the assignment would affect her ability to prevail. But the time that the contractor defaulted on the bank's loan is irrelevant to her success.

Educational objective: An assignee assumes all of the assignor's contractual rights that exist at the time of the assignment. However, the assignment is subject to any claims or defenses that (1) the obligor could have raised before receiving notice of the assignment or (2) stem from the assignor's failure to perform.

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 6%，C选项 33%，D选项 54%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

合同权利的转让


限制实质性地增加了债务人的合同义务或风险，实质性地减少了债务人获得履约的机会，或根据合同条款该转让无效（而不仅仅是被禁止）
要求当下立即转让权利的意图，通常需要对价以使转让不可撤销。

例外情况：禁止反言（promissory estoppel），交付象征所转让权利的文件（例如，股票证书），交付书面且已签署的转让文件
受让人的权利承继转让人在转让时合同项下的所有权利，但须受制于以下索赔/抗辩：

在债务人收到转让通知前已产生的索赔/抗辩，或源于转让人现在或未来的不履约。转让人丧失权利，因此不能执行合同。
合同的一方通常可以自由地转让（即，转移）其合同权利给另一方。这些权利的接收方（受让人）随后取代转让方（转让人）的地位，并承继转让人在转让时所拥有的、针对债务人履约的所有合同权利。然而，这些权利受制于任何符合以下条件的索赔或抗辩：
  • 在债务人收到转让通知之前已经产生的，或
  • 源于转让人现在或未来的不履约（选项B）。


在本案中，承包商将其合同权利转让给了银行——包括在银行贷款金额（8,000美元）的限度内，就合同项下所欠款项起诉房主的权利。然而，银行的可收回款项受制于房主因承包商随后未能完成车库而享有的8,000美元的抵消权。由于这完全抵消了银行可收回的款项，法院将裁定房主胜诉。

（选项A）有担保和无担保债权的优先顺序在破产程序以及其他需要按优先顺序偿付债权的情况下是相关的。但在本案中，银行对承包商的有担保债权人地位不影响房主抵消银行可收回款项的权利。

（选项C）如果房主的索赔与承包商的不履约无关，那么违约的时间以及她收到转让通知的时间将会影响她胜诉的可能性。但承包商拖欠银行贷款的时间与她能否胜诉无关。

教学目标：受让人承继转让人在转让时存在的所有合同权利。然而，该转让受制于（1）债务人在收到转让通知前可以提出的任何索赔或抗辩，或（2）源于转让人不履约的任何索赔或抗辩。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 336 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (defenses against assignee).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Third-Party Rights (Assignment)
⚖️ 核心法则：受让人的权利边界

在合同法中，受让人（Assignee）"steps into the shoes of the assignor"（步入转让人的后尘）。

这意味着受让人获得的权利，受制于债务人（Obligor）对转让人（Assignor）拥有的所有抗辩（Defenses）和抵销权（Recoupment/Set-off）。

案情图解

角色分配：

  • 债务人 (Obligor): 房主 (Homeowner)
  • 转让人 (Assignor): 承包商 (Contractor)
  • 受让人 (Assignee): 银行 (Bank)

关键事实：

  1. 承包商将收款权转让给银行。
  2. 承包商随后违约（放弃工程）。
  3. 房主因承包商违约遭受损失（需额外花费$8,000）。
  4. 银行起诉房主要求支付$8,000。
✅ 正确答案：D
房主胜诉，因为她因承包商违约而享有的抵消权（Recoupment）可以向作为承包商受让人的银行主张。

法律推理：

根据《合同法重述（第二次）》§ 336：

1. 同一合同产生的抗辩 (Recoupment)： 如果债务人（房主）的抗辩或索赔源于同一合同（本案中即建造车库的合同），无论该抗辩是在转让通知之前还是之后产生的，债务人都可以用它来对抗受让人（银行）。

2. 计算结果： 银行想要$8,000，但房主因同一合同的违约有$8,000的损失。房主行使抵消权（Recoupment）后，需支付金额为零。

❌ 陷阱选项辨析
选项 A (优先级)： 错误。担保债权人（Secured Creditor）的优先级通常用于破产程序中与其他债权人争夺资产。这里是合同诉讼，银行不能从房主那里获得比承包商原本拥有的更多的权利。
选项 B (通知时间)： 错误。这是最大的干扰项。虽然对于无关合同的抵销（Set-off），通知时间是分界线；但对于同一合同产生的不履约抗辩（Recoupment），即使违约发生在通知之后，房主依然可以抗辩。
选项 C (贷款违约时间)： 错误。承包商何时对银行违约与房主对承包商的抗辩权无关。
💡 MBE 提分技巧：
遇到“权利转让”（Assignment）题目时，记住口诀："Assignee takes subject to defenses"（受让人受制于抗辩）。

特别注意区分：
  • Recoupment (同一合同): 随时可以对抗受让人。
  • Set-off (不同交易): 只有在收到转让通知前产生的才能对抗。

A builder borrowed $10,000 from a lender to finance a small construction job under a contract with a homeowner. The builder gave the lender a writing that stated, "Any money I receive from the homeowner will be paid immediately to the lender, regardless of any demands from other creditors." The builder died after completing the job but before the homeowner paid. The lender demanded that the homeowner pay the $10,000 due to the builder directly to the lender. The homeowner refused, saying that he would pay directly to the builder's estate everything that he owed the builder.
Is the lender likely to succeed in an action against the homeowner for $10,000?

choices.a: No, because the builder's death terminated the lender's right to receive payment directly from the homeowner.
choices.b: No, because the writing the builder gave to the lender did not transfer to the lender the right to receive payment from the homeowner.
choices.c: Yes, because the builder had manifested an intent that the homeowner pay the $10,000 directly to the lender.
choices.d: Yes, because the lender is an intended beneficiary of the builder-homeowner contract.

一位建筑商从贷款人处借款10,000美元，用于根据与房主的合同为一项小型建筑工程融资。建筑商给了贷款人一份书面文件，其中写道：“我从房主处收到的任何款项将立即支付给贷款人，不论其他债权人有任何要求。”建筑商在完成工作后但在房主付款前去世。贷款人要求房主将应付给建筑商的10,000美元直接支付给贷款人。房主拒绝了，称他会把他欠建筑商的所有款项直接支付给建筑商的遗产。

贷款人对房主提起诉讼，要求其支付10,000美元，是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the builder's death terminated the lender's right to receive payment directly from the homeowner.
否，因为建筑商的死亡终止了贷款人直接从房主处收款的权利。

B. No, because the writing the builder gave to the lender did not transfer to the lender the right to receive payment from the homeowner.
否，因为建筑商给贷款人的书面文件并未将从房主处收款的权利转让给贷款人。

C. Yes, because the builder had manifested an intent that the homeowner pay the $10,000 directly to the lender.
是，因为建筑商已表明意图，希望房主将10,000美元直接支付给贷款人。

D. Yes, because the lender is an intended beneficiary of the builder-homeowner contract.
是，因为贷款人是建筑商-房主合同的意定受益人。

Assignment of contractual rights


LimitationsAssignment permitted unless it:
  • materially increases obligor's contractual duties or risks
  • materially reduces obligor's chance of obtaining performance or
  • is void (not merely prohibited) under contract provision
Requirements
  • Present intent to immediately assign right
  • Consideration generally required to make assignment irrevocable
  • Exceptions: promissory estoppel, delivery of document symbolizing assigned right (eg, stock certificate), delivery of written & signed assignment
Assignee's
rights		Assumes all of assignor's rights as contract stands at time of assignment, subject to claims/defenses that:
  • accrued before obligor received notice of assignment or
  • stem from assignor's present or future failure to perform
Assignor loses rights & therefore cannot enforce contract
An assignment is the transfer of rights under a contract to another (ie, assignee). No formalities are needed for an assignment, but there must be a present intent to transfer the rights immediately. A party's promise to pay money received pursuant to a contract to a third party is not an assignment of the party's contractual rights, but a promise of future payment. Therefore, the third party in that situation is not an assignee.

Here, the builder promised to pay the lender the $10,000 the builder received from the homeowner pursuant to the builder-homeowner contract. This promise of future payment was not an assignment and therefore did not transfer to the lender the right to receive payment directly from the homeowner. As a result, the lender is unlikely to succeed in an action against the homeowner for $10,000.

(Choice A) A gratuitous assignment (ie, one that is not supported by consideration) is automatically revoked upon the death, incapacity, or bankruptcy of the assignor. But no valid assignment occurred here, so the builder's death is irrelevant.

(Choice C) Regardless of the builder's subjective intent, the lender was not an assignee and therefore has no right to receive the $10,000 payment directly from the homeowner.

(Choice D) The lender was not an intended beneficiary of the builder-homeowner contract because the contract did not provide that the homeowner would pay the $10,000 directly to the lender.

Educational objective: A party's promise to pay money received pursuant to a contract to a third party is not an assignment of the party's contractual rights, but a promise of future payment.

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 51%（正确选项），C选项 7%，D选项 36%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

合同权利的转让


限制允许转让，除非其：
  • 实质性地增加了义务人的合同义务或风险
  • 实质性地减少了义务人获得履约的机会 或
  • 根据合同条款无效（而不仅仅是被禁止）
要求
  • 立即转让权利的当期意图
  • 通常需要对价以使转让不可撤销
  • 例外：允诺禁反言、交付象征所转让权利的文件（例如，股票证书）、交付书面并签署的转让文件
受让人
的权利		承继转让人在转让时合同项下的所有权利，但须受制于以下抗辩/主张：
  • 在义务人收到转让通知前已经产生的 或
  • 源于转让人当前或未来的不履行
转让人丧失权利，因此不能执行合同
转让是指将合同项下的权利转移给另一方（即受让人）。转让无需遵循特定形式，但必须有立即转让权利的当期意图。一方承诺将根据合同收到的款项支付给第三方，这不是对该方合同权利的转让，而是对未来付款的承诺。因此，在这种情况下，该第三方不是受让人。

在本案中，建筑商承诺将根据建筑商-房主合同从房主处收到的10,000美元支付给贷款人。这个未来付款的承诺不是一次转让，因此并未将直接从房主处收款的权利转移给贷款人。因此，贷款人对房主提起诉讼，要求其支付10,000美元，不大可能胜诉。

(选项A) 无偿转让（即没有对价支持的转让）在转让人死亡、丧失行为能力或破产时自动撤销。但本案中并未发生有效的转让，因此建筑商的死亡是无关紧要的。

(选项C) 无论建筑商的主观意图如何，贷款人都不是受让人，因此无权直接从房主处收取10,000美元的款项。

(选项D) 贷款人不是建筑商-房主合同的意定受益人，因为该合同并未规定房主将10,000美元直接支付给贷款人。

教学目的：一方承诺将根据合同收到的款项支付给第三方，这不是对该方合同权利的转让，而是对未来付款的承诺。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 321 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (assignment of future rights).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Third-Party Rights
✅ 正确答案：B

贷款人（Lender）无法直接起诉房主（Homeowner）。因为建筑商（Builder）签署的文件仅仅是一个未来付款的承诺，而不是有效的债权转让（Assignment）。

核心考点：债权转让 vs. 付款承诺

在合同法中，要构成有效的债权转让 (Assignment of Rights)，让与人（Assignor）必须表现出立即转移 (Present Intent to Transfer) 权利的意图。

关键区别在于权利的控制权：

  • 转让 (Assignment): 让与人放弃了向债务人收款的权利，受让人（Assignee）直接取代其位置。
  • 付款承诺 (Promise to Pay): 让与人保留向债务人收款的权利，只是承诺收到钱后再转给第三方。
本案分析

题目中的关键措辞是：

"Any money I receive from the homeowner will be paid..."

（“我从房主处收到的任何款项将支付给……”）

这句话表明：

  1. 建筑商打算自己先收款（"I receive"）。
  2. 然后再付给贷款人。

这说明建筑商并没有把“直接向房主收款的权利”转移给贷款人。因此，贷款人与房主之间没有法律关系（Privity），贷款人不能直接起诉房主。

措辞类型 法律后果
"I hereby assign my rights under the contract to Lender."
（我特此将合同权利转让给贷款人）		 有效转让
贷款人可直接起诉房主。
"Pay Lender directly."
（直接付给贷款人）		 有效转让
表明放弃收款权。
"I will pay you whatever I collect."
（我会把收到的钱付给你）		 无效转让
仅为个人承诺，贷款人只能起诉建筑商（或其遗产）。
排除干扰项
❌ 选项 A (关于死亡):
如果这是一个有效的“有偿转让”（Assignment for Value），让与人的死亡不会终止转让。本题错误的原因是根本没有发生转让，而不是因为建筑商死了。
❌ 选项 C (关于意图):
虽然建筑商有意图让贷款人拿到钱，但他表现出的意图是“我收钱后给你”，而不是“你直接去收钱”。法律看重的是权利转移的具体方式。
❌ 选项 D (意定受益人 Intended Beneficiary):
意定受益人必须在原合同（建筑商与房主）订立时就被考虑在内。本案中，贷款协议是后来才发生的，所以贷款人只是附带受益人（Incidental Beneficiary），无权执行原合同。
💡 MBE 解题技巧

看到涉及第三方的金钱支付题目时，仔细检查措辞：

如果是 "I will pay you from the fund"（我会用这笔资金付你）👉 不是转让。

如果是 "You are entitled to the fund"（你有权获得这笔资金）👉 是转让。
